-- ==== 00_loader : loading HUD + resume marker (ChilliHubLoadStep) ====
do
	local genv = ((typeof(getgenv) == "function") and getgenv()) or _G
	genv.ChilliCanvasHold = true
	local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

	pcall(function()
		local hui = gethui()

		if typeof(hui) == "Instance" then
			CoreGui = hui
		end
	end)

	local chilliHubLoading = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("ChilliHubLoading")

	if chilliHubLoading then
		chilliHubLoading:Destroy()
	end

	local chilliHubLoading2 = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	chilliHubLoading2.Name = "ChilliHubLoading"
	chilliHubLoading2.ResetOnSpawn = false
	chilliHubLoading2.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	chilliHubLoading2.DisplayOrder = 1000
	chilliHubLoading2.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	chilliHubLoading = Instance.new("Frame")
	chilliHubLoading.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	chilliHubLoading.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 24)
	chilliHubLoading.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 64)
	chilliHubLoading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
	chilliHubLoading.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
	chilliHubLoading.Parent = chilliHubLoading2
	Instance.new("UICorner", chilliHubLoading).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	local uiElement = Instance.new("UIStroke", chilliHubLoading)
	uiElement.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
	uiElement.Thickness = 1.5
	uiElement.Transparency = 0.2
	uiElement = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	uiElement.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	uiElement.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8)
	uiElement.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
	uiElement.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	uiElement.TextSize = 15
	uiElement.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	uiElement.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	uiElement.Text = "Chilli Hub"
	uiElement.Parent = chilliHubLoading
	local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8)
	textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
	textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	textLabel.TextSize = 15
	textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 90)
	textLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	textLabel.Text = "0%"
	textLabel.Parent = chilliHubLoading
	local textLabel2 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	textLabel2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textLabel2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 27)
	textLabel2.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14)
	textLabel2.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	textLabel2.TextSize = 12
	textLabel2.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 185)
	textLabel2.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	textLabel2.Text = "Loading part 1 / 10"
	textLabel2.Parent = chilliHubLoading
	uiElement = Instance.new("Frame")
	uiElement.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 46)
	uiElement.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 8)
	uiElement.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
	uiElement.Parent = chilliHubLoading
	Instance.new("UICorner", uiElement).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	frame.Parent = uiElement
	Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	Instance.new("UIGradient", frame).Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50), Color3.fromRGB(255,
		150, 60))
	chilliHubLoading2.Parent = CoreGui
	local filePath, tempValue = "ChilliLibrary/SAE_LoadProgress.txt"

	pcall(function()
		if isfile(filePath) then
			tempValue = tonumber(string.match(readfile(filePath), "^(%d+)"))
		end
	end)

	local function saveFile(text)
		pcall(function()
			if not (isfolder("ChilliLibrary")) then
				makefolder("ChilliLibrary")
			end

			writefile(filePath, tostring(text) .. (" " .. tostring(os.time())))
		end)
	end

	saveFile(0)
	genv.ChilliHubLoading = os.clock() + 30

	genv.ChilliHubLoadStep = function(input)
		local computed = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(input) or 0), 0, 10)
		saveFile(computed)

		pcall(function()
			frame.Size = UDim2.new(computed / 10, 0, 1, 0)
			textLabel.Text = tostring(computed * 10) .. "%"
			textLabel2.Text = ((computed >= 10) and "Loaded")
				or ("Loading part " .. (tostring(computed + 1) .. " / 10"))
		end)

		task.wait(0.05)

		if computed >= 10 then
			genv.ChilliHubLoadStep = nil
			genv.ChilliCanvasHold = nil
			genv.ChilliHubLoading = nil

			if tempValue and (tempValue < 10) then
				pcall(function()
					textLabel2.Text = "Last load stopped at " .. (tostring(tempValue * 10) .. ("% (part " .. (tostring(tempValue + 1) .. " / 10)")))
					textLabel2.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 90)
				end)

				task.delay(8, function()
					pcall(function()
						chilliHubLoading2:Destroy()
					end)
				end)
			else
				pcall(function()
					chilliHubLoading2:Destroy()
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(pcall, function()
	loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tienkhanh1/spicy/refs/heads/main/DiscordLink"))()
end)

-- ==== 01_uilib : ChilliLibrary widget toolkit (window/tabs/toggles/sliders/dropdowns/notify/config) ====
local function createUiLibrary()
	local items = {}

	do
		local gameRef = game

		local function getService(serviceName)
			return gameRef:GetService(serviceName)
		end

		local Players, TweenService = getService("Players"), getService("TweenService")
		local UserInputService = getService("UserInputService")
		local RunService = getService("RunService")
		local HttpService = getService("HttpService")
		local GuiService = getService("GuiService")
		local localPlayer, scrollingFrame = Players.LocalPlayer, Enum
		local color3FromRGB = Color3.fromRGB
		local uDim2New = UDim2.new
		local uDim2FromScale = UDim2.fromScale
		local uDim2FromOffset = UDim2.fromOffset
		local vector2New = Vector2.new
		local uDimNew = UDim.new
		local color3FromRGBResult = color3FromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		local color3FromRGBResult2 = color3FromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		local color3FromRGBResult3, textValue = color3FromRGB(58, 255,
			55), "rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json"
		local font = Font.new(textValue, scrollingFrame.FontWeight.ExtraBold, scrollingFrame.FontStyle.Normal)
		local font2 = Font.new(textValue, scrollingFrame.FontWeight.ExtraBold, scrollingFrame.FontStyle.Italic)
		local font3 = Font.fromEnum(scrollingFrame.Font.FredokaOne)

		local function scanTable(...)
			local iMap, items2 = {}, {...}

			for index3, item in ipairs(items2) do
				iMap[index3] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(item[1], item[2])
			end

			return ColorSequence.new(iMap)
		end

		local scanTableResult = scanTable({0, color3FromRGBResult}, {0.486159176, color3FromRGBResult}, {0.519031167,
			color3FromRGB(221, 221, 221)}, {1, color3FromRGB(236, 236, 236)})
		local scanTableResult2 = scanTable({0, color3FromRGB(0, 36, 84)}, {1, color3FromRGB(0, 31, 54)})
		local scanTableResult3 = scanTable({0, color3FromRGBResult3}, {1, color3FromRGB(20, 109, 0)})
		local scanTableResult4 = scanTable({0, color3FromRGB(255, 193, 194)}, {0.0570934266, color3FromRGB(255, 132,
			123)}, {1, color3FromRGB(239, 28, 28)})
		local scanTableResult5 = scanTable({0, color3FromRGB(255, 193, 194)}, {0.0155709349, color3FromRGB(255, 132,
			123)}, {1, color3FromRGB(239, 28, 28)})
		local touchEnabled = (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled)
			and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled
		local left = scrollingFrame.TextXAlignment.Left
		local center = scrollingFrame.HorizontalAlignment.Center
		local right = scrollingFrame.TextXAlignment.Right
		local quart = scrollingFrame.EasingStyle.Quart
		local quint, connections = scrollingFrame.EasingStyle.Quint, {}

		local function trackConnection(event, input)
			local connection = event:Connect(input)
			connections[#connections + 1] = connection
			return connection
		end

		local textValues = {TextLabel = 1, TextButton = 1, TextBox = 1}

		local function createInstance(className, instance2)
			local instance = Instance.new(className)

			if textValues[className] then
				instance.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				instance.Text = ""
			end

			if className == "TextButton" then
				instance.AutoButtonColor = false
			elseif className == "ImageButton" then
				instance.AutoButtonColor = false
			end

			if className == "TextBox" then
				instance.ClearTextOnFocus = false
			end

			if instance:IsA("GuiObject") then
				instance.BorderSizePixel = 0
			end

			if instance2 then
				for key, value in next, instance2, nil do
					if type(key) ~= "number" then
						if key ~= "Parent" then
							instance[key] = value
						end
					end
				end

				for _, item in ipairs(instance2) do
					item.Parent = instance
				end

				instance.Parent = instance2.Parent
			end

			return instance
		end

		local function tryCall(firstValue, input, input2, input3)
			local UIStroke = createInstance("UIStroke", {Thickness = firstValue, Color = input or color3FromRGBResult2,
				ApplyStrokeMode = (input2 and scrollingFrame.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual)
				or scrollingFrame.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, LineJoinMode = scrollingFrame.LineJoinMode.Round, Transparency = input3 or 0})

			pcall(function()
				UIStroke.BorderOffset = uDimNew(0, 0)
				UIStroke.BorderStrokePosition = scrollingFrame.BorderStrokePosition.Outer
				UIStroke.StrokeSizingMode = scrollingFrame.StrokeSizingMode.ScaledSize
			end)

			return UIStroke
		end

		local function getUIGradient(firstValue, input)
			return createInstance("UIGradient", {Color = firstValue, Rotation = 90, Name = input or "UIGradient"})
		end

		local function getUIAspectRatioConstraint(input, input2)
			return createInstance("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = input or 1,
				DominantAxis = (input2 and scrollingFrame.DominantAxis.Height) or scrollingFrame.DominantAxis.Width})
		end

		local function doStep(parent)
			parent.FontFace = font
			parent.TextColor3 = color3FromRGBResult
			parent.TextScaled = true
			parent.LineHeight = 1
			tryCall(0.08, color3FromRGBResult2, true).Parent = parent
			return parent
		end

		local function checkState(parent, fontFace)
			if fontFace then
				parent.FontFace = fontFace
			end

			parent.TextColor3 = color3FromRGBResult
			parent.TextScaled = true
			parent.LineHeight = 1
			getUIGradient(scanTableResult, "TextStyleGradient").Parent = parent
			fontFace = tryCall(0.065, color3FromRGBResult, true)
			getUIGradient(scanTableResult2, "StrokeStyleGradient").Parent = fontFace
			fontFace.Parent = parent
			return parent
		end

		local function checkState2(input, input2)
			local TextLabel = createInstance("TextLabel", input)
			if input2 then
				return checkState(TextLabel, ((input2 == true) and font) or input2)
			end
			return doStep(TextLabel)
		end

		local function doStep2(data)
			data.TextTransparency = 0.32
			local uiStroke = data:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			uiStroke.Thickness = 0.06
			uiStroke.Transparency = 0.2
			return data
		end

		local function animate(input, input2, input3, input4, input5)
			local tween = TweenService:Create(input, TweenInfo.new(input3 or 0.15,
				input4 or scrollingFrame.EasingStyle.Quad, input5 or scrollingFrame.EasingDirection.Out), input2)
			tween:Play()
			return tween
		end

		local function doStep3(data)
			local userInputType = data.UserInputType
			return (userInputType == scrollingFrame.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
				or (userInputType == scrollingFrame.UserInputType.Touch)
		end

		items.errs = {}

		local function tryCall2(callback, ...)
			if callback then
				local callResult, text = pcall(callback, ...)

				if not (callResult) then
					warn("[Chilli] " .. tostring(text))

					if #items.errs < 50 then
						items.errs[#items.errs + 1] = tostring(text)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local function animate2(firstValue, input, input2)
			local uiScale, tempValue, tempValue2 = firstValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
				or createInstance("UIScale", {Parent = firstValue, Name = "InteractionScale"}), false

			local function playTween(input3, input4)
				if tempValue2 then
					tempValue2:Cancel()
				end

				tempValue2 = animate(uiScale, {Scale = input3}, input4)
			end

			trackConnection(firstValue.MouseEnter, function()
				tempValue = true
				playTween(input, 0.1)
			end)

			trackConnection(firstValue.MouseLeave, function()
				tempValue = false
				playTween(1, 0.1)
			end)

			trackConnection(firstValue.MouseButton1Down, function()
				playTween(input2, 0.055)
			end)

			trackConnection(firstValue.MouseButton1Up, function()
				playTween((tempValue and input) or 1, 0.08)
			end)

			return uiScale
		end

		local setmetatableFn, weakCache = setmetatable, {__mode = "k"}
		local setmetatableFnResult = setmetatableFn({}, weakCache)

		local function doStep4(instance, input)
			local absolutePosition, absoluteSize = instance.AbsolutePosition, instance.AbsoluteSize
			return ((((instance.Parent and instance.Visible) and (input.X >= absolutePosition.X)) and (input.X <= (absolutePosition.X + absoluteSize.X))) and (input.Y >= absolutePosition.Y))
				and (input.Y <= (absolutePosition.Y + absoluteSize.Y))
		end

		trackConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
			local entry = setmetatableFnResult[input]

			if entry then
				entry.p = vector2New(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)

				if (entry.p - entry.s).Magnitude > 10 then
					entry.x = true
				end
			end
		end)

		local function hit(firstValue, input2)
			firstValue.Active = true

			trackConnection(firstValue.InputBegan, function(input)
				if input.UserInputType == scrollingFrame.UserInputType.Touch then
					if input.UserInputState == scrollingFrame.UserInputState.Begin then
						local vector2NewResult = vector2New(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
						setmetatableFnResult[input] = {b = firstValue, s = vector2NewResult, p = vector2NewResult}
					end
				end
			end)

			return trackConnection(firstValue.Activated, function(inputObject)
				if inputObject then
					if inputObject.UserInputType == scrollingFrame.UserInputType.Touch then
						local lookupValue = setmetatableFnResult[inputObject]

						if lookupValue then
							if lookupValue.b ~= firstValue then
								return
							elseif lookupValue.x then
								return
							elseif not (doStep4(firstValue, lookupValue.p)) then
								return
							end
						else
							return
						end
					end
				end

				tryCall2(input2)
			end)
		end

		local items3 = {}

		trackConnection(RunService.Heartbeat, function()
			if #items3 > 0 then
				local items3Ref = items3
				items3 = {}

				for _, item in ipairs(items3Ref) do
					tryCall2(item)
				end
			end
		end)

		items.q = function(input)
			local items3Ref = items3
			items3Ref[#items3Ref + 1] = input
		end

		local function chev(firstValue, input, firstValue2, input2, input3, input4, input5)
			local Frame, items2 = createInstance("Frame", {Parent = firstValue, Name = "Caret",
				AnchorPoint = vector2New(0.5,
				0.5), Position = firstValue2, Size = input2, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = input3
				or 1, getUIAspectRatioConstraint(1, not input5)}), {{0.335355, 45}, {0.664645, -45}}

			for _, item in ipairs(items2) do
				createInstance("Frame", {Parent = Frame, Name = "Arm", AnchorPoint = vector2New(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = uDim2FromScale(item[1], 0.535355), Rotation = item[2], Size = uDim2FromScale(0.6657,
					input4 or 0.2), BackgroundColor3 = input, ZIndex = (input3 or 1) + 1})
			end

			return Frame
		end

		local function doStep5(instance)
			local TextButton = createInstance("TextButton", {Parent = instance.Parent,
				Name = (instance.Name or instance.Text) or "Button", AnchorPoint = instance.AnchorPoint or vector2New(0.5,
				0.5), Position = instance.Position
				or uDim2FromScale(0.5,
				0.5), Size = instance.Size, LayoutOrder = instance.LayoutOrder or 0, ZIndex = instance.ZIndex or 99})
			local Frame = createInstance("Frame", {Parent = TextButton, Name = "Main", AnchorPoint = vector2New(0.5,
				0.5), Position = uDim2FromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = uDim2FromScale(1, (instance.full and 1)
				or 0.92), BackgroundColor3 = color3FromRGB(175, 0, 0), tryCall((instance.full and 0.07) or 0.06)})
			local Frame2 = createInstance("Frame", {Parent = Frame, Name = "ColorFrame", AnchorPoint = vector2New(0.5,
				0), Position = uDim2FromScale(0.5, 0), Size = uDim2FromScale(1, 0.9), BackgroundColor3 = color3FromRGBResult, getUIGradient(scanTableResult4, "RedGradient")})
			local Frame3, checkState2Result = createInstance("Frame", {Parent = Frame2, Name = "Transparent",
				AnchorPoint = vector2New(0.5, 0.5), Position = uDim2FromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = uDim2FromScale(0.965,
				0.88), BackgroundColor3 = color3FromRGBResult, ZIndex = 2, getUIGradient(scanTableResult5, "RedGradient")}), checkState2({Parent = Frame2, Name = "Label", AnchorPoint = vector2New(0.5, 0.5), Position = uDim2FromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = instance.LSize
				or uDim2FromScale(0.94,
				0.72), Text = instance.Text or "", TextWrapped = instance.wrap == true, ZIndex = 6}, true)
			animate2(TextButton, instance.h or 1.035, instance.p or 0.96)
			return TextButton, Frame, checkState2Result, Frame2, Frame3
		end

		local function doStep6(firstValue, input, data, input2, input3, input4)
			local Frame = createInstance("Frame", {Parent = firstValue, Name = "Switch", AnchorPoint = vector2New(input,
				0.5), Position = uDim2FromScale(data, 0.5), Size = uDim2FromScale(input2, input3), BackgroundColor3 = color3FromRGBResult, ZIndex = input4
				or 3, tryCall(0.06)})
			local UIGradient = createInstance("UIGradient", {Parent = Frame, Name = "OFF",
				Color = ColorSequence.new(color3FromRGBResult2), Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.6)})
			local uiGradient = getUIGradient(scanTableResult3, "ON")
			uiGradient.Parent = Frame
			input2, input3, firstValue, data = {Parent = Frame, Name = "Hold", AnchorPoint = vector2New(0.5, 0.5),
				Size = uDim2FromScale(0.72, 0.72), BackgroundColor3 = color3FromRGB(89, 89,
				89), ZIndex = (input4
				or 3) + 2}, tryCall(0.09), getUIAspectRatioConstraint(1), {Name = "Color", AnchorPoint = vector2New(0.5, 0), Position = uDim2FromScale(0.5, 0), Size = uDim2FromScale(1, 0.9), BackgroundColor3 = color3FromRGBResult}
			data.ZIndex = (input4 or 3) + 3

			do
				local packedValues = table.pack(input3, firstValue, createInstance("Frame", data))
				table.move(packedValues, 1, packedValues.n, 1, input2)
			end

			local Frame2 = createInstance("Frame", input2)

			return Frame, function(enabled, input5)
				UIGradient.Enabled = not enabled
				uiGradient.Enabled = enabled
				local uDim2FromScaleResult = uDim2FromScale((enabled and 0.72) or 0.28, 0.5)

				if input5 == false then
					Frame2.Position = uDim2FromScaleResult
				else
					animate(Frame2, {Position = uDim2FromScaleResult}, 0.12)
				end
			end
		end

		items.N = createInstance
		items.L = checkState2
		items.st = tryCall
		items.gr = getUIGradient
		items.tw = animate
		items.hit = hit
		items.chev = chev
		items.rb = doStep5
		items.cn = trackConnection
		items.fb = animate2
		items.ACC = scanTableResult3
		items.RED1 = scanTableResult4
		items.SHN = scanTableResult
		items.SHS = scanTableResult2
		items.FN = font
		items.FR = font3

		local function readCachedFile(input)
			local callResult, result = pcall(readfile, input)
			return (callResult and result) or nil
		end

		local function saveFile(input, input2)
			pcall(writefile, input, input2)
		end

		local function ensureFolder(input)
			if isfolder then
				if not (isfolder(input)) then
					pcall(makefolder, input)
				end
			end
		end

		local function dec(input)
			if not (input) then
				return
			end
			local callResult, result = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, input)
			return (callResult and result) or nil
		end

		local function enc(input)
			local callResult, result = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, input)
			return (callResult and result) or nil
		end

		items.dec = dec
		items.enc = enc
		items.rd = readCachedFile
		items.wr = saveFile
		local amount, amount2, amount3 = 1000, 3, 12

		local function roundSigFigs(amount4)
			if amount4 <= 0 then
				return 0
			end
			local factor = 10 ^ (math.floor(math.log10(amount4)) - 2)
			return math.floor((amount4 / factor) + 0.5) * factor
		end

		local function clampValue(threshold)
			threshold = math.clamp(tonumber(threshold) or 0, 0, amount)
			return ((threshold <= 0) and 0)
				or roundSigFigs(10 ^ (amount2 + (((amount3 - amount2) * threshold) / amount)))
		end

		local function roundSigFigs2(threshold)
			threshold = tonumber(threshold) or 0
			if threshold <= 0 then
				return 0
			end
			return math.clamp(math.floor(((((math.log10(threshold) - amount2) / (amount3 - amount2)) * amount) * 100) + 0.5) / 100,
				0, amount)
		end

		local function doStep7(threshold)
			local stringFormat, isRecent = string.format, ((threshold >= 100) and "%.0f")
				or ((threshold >= 10) and "%.1f")
			local stringFormatResult = stringFormat(isRecent or "%.2f", threshold)
			return if stringFormatResult:find(".", 1, true) then stringFormatResult:gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$",
				"") else stringFormatResult
		end

		local function formatRate(input)
			local numVal = clampValue(input)

			if numVal <= 0 then
				return "Off"
			elseif numVal < 1000000 then
				return doStep7(numVal / 1000) .. " K/s"
			elseif numVal < 1000000000 then
				return doStep7(numVal / 1000000) .. " M/s"
			end

			return doStep7(numVal / 1000000000) .. " B/s"
		end

		local function formatCompact(input)
			local numVal = clampValue(input)

			if numVal <= 0 then
				return "0"
			elseif numVal < 1000000 then
				return doStep7(numVal / 1000) .. "k"
			end

			return (string.format("%.3f", numVal / 1000000):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", ""))
		end

		local unitMultipliers = {k = 1000, m = 1000000, b = 1000000000, t = 1000000000000}

		local function doStep8(input)
			input = tostring(input or ""):gsub("[%s,/]", ""):lower():gsub("s$", "")

			if input == "" then
				return 0
			elseif input == "off" then
				return 0
			end

		end

		weakCache, setmetatableFn = setmetatable, {__mode = "k"}

		local function checkState5(data, input)
			if not (data) then
				return
			end
			local entry = weakCacheResult[data]

			if entry then
				if data.Text ~= entry.p then
					weakCacheResult[data] = nil
					entry = nil
				else
				end
			else
			end

			if entry then
			else
				if input == "" then
					return
				elseif data.RichText then
					return
				end

				entry = {t = data.Text}
				weakCacheResult[data] = entry
			end

			local pos, tempValue

			if input ~= "" then
				pos, tempValue = entry.t:lower():find(input, 1, true)
			else
			end

			if not (pos) then
				data.RichText, data.Text = false, entry.t
				weakCacheResult[data] = nil
				return
			end

			local function isValue(text)
				return (text:gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;"))
			end

			data.RichText = true
			data.Text = isValue(entry.t:sub(1,
				pos - 1)) .. ("<font color=\"rgb(58,255,55)\">" .. (isValue(entry.t:sub(pos,
				tempValue)) .. ("</font>" .. isValue(entry.t:sub(tempValue + 1)))))
			entry.p = data.Text
		end

		local function doStep14(data)
			local text = tostring(data.Disp or data.Name)

			if text:lower():sub(-4) == " tab" then
				return text
			elseif text:lower() == "tab" then
				return text
			end

			return text .. " Tab"
		end

		index.Search = function(data, visible)
			local cur = data.Cur
			if not (cur) then
				return
			end
			local tempValue = (tostring(visible or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""):lower()

			for index3, section in ipairs(cur.Sections) do
				if not (section.res) then
					index3 = (tempValue == "") or (section.Disp:lower():find(tempValue, 1, true) ~= nil)
					visible = if section.extra then (section.extra(tempValue) == true) or index3 else index3
					checkState5(section.hd, tempValue)

					for index4, row in ipairs(section.rows) do
						index4 = row.o

						if index4 or row.canvas then
							local tempValue2, tempValue4 = (tempValue == "") or index3

							if tempValue2 then
								tempValue4 = tempValue2
							else
								local tostringFn, disp = tostring, index4 and (index4.Disp or index4.Name)
								tempValue4 = tostringFn(disp or row.name):lower():find(tempValue, 1, true) ~= nil
							end

							if row.apply then
								if tempValue == "" then
									if row.q ~= nil then
										row.q = nil
										row.shown = nil
										row.apply(false)
									end
								else
									if row.q == nil then
										row.qv = row.shown ~= false
									end

									row.q = tempValue4
									row.h.Visible = tempValue4 and row.qv
								end
							else
								row.h.Visible = tempValue4
							end

							if row.lb then
								checkState5(row.lb, tempValue)
							end

							visible = if tempValue4 then true else visible
						else
						end
					end

					if tempValue == "" then
						section.f.Visible = true

						if section.pre ~= nil then
							section:Expand(section.pre, false)
							section.pre = nil
						end
					else
						if section.pre == nil then
							section.pre = section.open
						end

						section.f.Visible = visible

						if visible then
							if not (section.open) then
								section:Expand(true, false)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			data:Cross(cur, tempValue)
			task.defer(cur.canvas)
		end

		index.Apply = function(data, value2)

				if not (opt.Skip) then
					if opt.Type ~= "button" then
						if opt.Type ~= "text" then
							index3 = ((values[opt.Tab] and values[opt.Tab][opt.Sec]) and values[opt.Tab][opt.Sec][opt.Name])
								or scanTable4(values, opt.Sec, opt.Name)

							value = if value == nil then ((type(opt.Def) == "table") and table.clone(opt.Def))
								or opt.Def else value

							if value ~= nil then
								pcall(opt.Set, opt, value)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			for key, value in next, ((type(value2.States) == "table") and value2.States) or {}, nil do
				values = data.St[key]

				if (values and (type(value) == "table")) and (value.Value ~= nil) then
					values.Value = value.Value

					for _, item in ipairs(values.ls) do
						tryCall2(item, value.Value)
					end

					data:State(key, value.Value)
				end
			end

			data.busy = false

			if data.onLoad then
				tryCall2(data.onLoad)
			end

			return true
		end

		index.Load = function(data, text)
			local tempValue = data:Find(text)
			if not (tempValue) then
				return false, "Config does not exist: " .. tostring(text)
			end

			local function isValues(value)
				return (type(value) == "table") and ((type(value.Values) == "table") or (type(value.States) == "table"))
			end

			text = dec(readCachedFile(isValue2(data, tempValue)))

			if isValues(text) then
			else
				text = dec(readCachedFile(isValue2(data, tempValue) .. ".bak"))

				if isValues(text) then
					saveFile(isValue2(data, tempValue), enc(text) or "")
				end
			end

			if not (isValues(text)) then
				return false, "Config file is empty or invalid."
			end
			data.Active = tempValue
			data:Apply(text)

			if data.AutoSave then
				if data.ready then
					data:Save()
				end
			end

			if data.cfgNotes then
				data.cfgNotes()
			end

			return true
		end

		index.List = function(text)
			local cache, list3, callResult, result = {[textValue3:lower()] = textValue3}, {}, pcall(listfiles,
				text.dirP .. "/configs")

			for _, item in ipairs((callResult and result) or {}) do
				text = tostring(item):gsub("\\", "/"):match("([^/]+)%.json$")

				if text then
					if text ~= "" then
						cache[text:lower()] = text
					end
				end
			end

			for key, value in next, cache, nil do
				if key ~= textValue3:lower() then
					list3[#list3 + 1] = value
				end
			end

			table.sort(list3, function(text2, text3)
				return text2:lower() < text3:lower()
			end)

			table.insert(list3, 1, textValue3)
			return list3
		end

						end
					end
				end

					end

					end

					if if iEntry2 then #iEntry == 0 else not iEntry2 then
						item2.pn.Visible = false
					else

						isValueResult = ((#iEntry - 1) * factor3) + (#iEntry * factor)
						local tempValue9 = (factor2 + factor3) + isValueResult
						item2.frac = isValueResult / tempValue9

						if item2.tw then
							item2.tw:Cancel()
							item2.tw = nil
						end

			end

			local function checkState3(items4)
				items4 = tostring(items4 or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""

				if items4 == "" then
					return
				elseif #items4 > 48 then
					return
				elseif items4:find("[<>:\"/\\|%?%*%c]") then
					return
				elseif items4:find("[%. ]$") then
					return
				end

				local tempValue7 = items4:upper():gsub("%..*$", "")

				if tempValue7 == "CON" then
					return
				elseif tempValue7 == "PRN" then
					return
				elseif tempValue7 == "AUX" then
					return
				elseif tempValue7 == "NUL" then
					return
				elseif tempValue7 == "CLOCK$" then
					return
				elseif tempValue7:match("^COM%d$") then
					return
				elseif tempValue7:match("^LPT%d$") then
					return
				end

				return items4
			end

		index.Finish = function(input)
			local inputRef = input
			inputRef.ready = true

			tryCall2(function()
				if not (isfile and isfile(isValue2(inputRef, "Default"))) then
					inputRef:Save("Default", inputRef:Collect())
				end

				local startup = inputRef.Startup

				if not (inputRef:Find(startup)) then
					inputRef.Startup = "Default"
				end

				inputRef.Active = inputRef.Startup
			end)

			if inputRef.AutoLoad then
				tryCall2(function()
					for index3 = 1, 6, 1 do
						index3 = inputRef.Startup
						if inputRef:Load(index3) then
							break
						end
						task.wait(0.4)
					end
				end)
			end

			inputRef.busy = false
			tryCall2(inputRef.qSync)
			tryCall2(inputRef.cfgNotes)

			tryCall2(function()
				if inputRef.sizeOpt then
					if inputRef.sizeOpt.Value ~= 100 then
						inputRef:Scale(inputRef.sizeOpt.Value / 100)
					end
				end
			end)

			tryCall2(function()
				inputRef:Select(inputRef.Tabs[1])
			end)

			inputRef.gui.Enabled = true

			task.spawn(function()
				for index3 = 1, 5, 1 do
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				local openOnLaunch = inputRef.St["Open On Launch"]

				if openOnLaunch then
					if openOnLaunch.Value ~= false then
						inputRef:Show(true)
					end
				else
					inputRef:Show(true)
				end
			end)
		end

		local function destroyInstances2(parent, color, rotation)
			local chilliCanvasGradient = parent:FindFirstChild("ChilliCanvasGradient")

			if color == nil then

					chilliCanvasGradient:Destroy()
				end

				return
			end

			if typeof(color) == "Instance" then
				if color:IsA("UIGradient") then
					if chilliCanvasGradient then
						chilliCanvasGradient:Destroy()
					end

					local callResult, result = pcall(color.Clone, color)

					if callResult then
						if result then
							result.Name = "ChilliCanvasGradient"

							if rotation ~= nil then
								result.Rotation = rotation
							end

							result.Parent = parent
						end
					end

					return
				end
			end

			if typeof(color) == "ColorSequence" then
				local chilliCanvasGradient2 = chilliCanvasGradient or createInstance("UIGradient",
					{Name = "ChilliCanvasGradient", Parent = parent})
				chilliCanvasGradient2.Color = color

				end
			end
		end

		local function collectDescendants(value)
			if typeof(value) ~= "Instance" then
				return
			end
			local callResult, result = pcall(value.Clone, value)

			if callResult then
				if not (result) then
					return
				end
			else
				return
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(result:GetDescendants()) do
				if ((descendant:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter")) or descendant:IsA("Trail"))
					or descendant:IsA("Beam") then
					descendant:Destroy()
				elseif descendant:IsA("Light") then
					descendant:Destroy()
				elseif descendant:IsA("Sound") then
					descendant:Destroy()
				elseif descendant:IsA("Fire") then
					descendant:Destroy()
				elseif descendant:IsA("Smoke") then
					descendant:Destroy()
				elseif descendant:IsA("Sparkles") then
					descendant:Destroy()
				elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
					descendant.Anchored = true
					descendant.CanCollide = false
					descendant.CastShadow = false
				end
			end

			if result:IsA("BasePart") then
				result.Anchored = true
			end

			return result
		end

		local function checkState7(value)
			if typeof(value) ~= "Instance" then
				return false
			else
				local gameRef2 = game
				if not (value:IsDescendantOf(gameRef2)) then
					return false
				end
			end

			local parent = value

			while parent do
				if parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
					if not (parent.Visible) then
						return false
					end
				end

				if parent:IsA("LayerCollector") then
					return parent.Enabled
				end
				parent = parent.Parent
			end

			return false
		end

-- ==== 02_sae : main feature script - owns ctx, then dispatches the runStep sections below ====
local function loadAllSections()
	local ctx = {}
	local totalSteps, completedSteps, milestoneStep, parts = 43, 0, 0, {}

	local function runStep(stepName, stepFunction)
		pcall(writefile, "ChilliLibrary/SAE_LoadPart.txt", stepName)

		local callResult, text = xpcall(stepFunction, function(text2)
			return tostring(text2) .. (" | " .. tostring(debug.traceback()):sub(1, 400))
		end)

		if not (callResult) then
			parts[#parts + 1] = stepName .. (": " .. tostring(text))
			warn("[Chilli] " .. (stepName .. (" failed: " .. tostring(text))))
		end

		completedSteps += 1
		stepName = math.floor((completedSteps / totalSteps) * 9)

		if stepName > milestoneStep then
			milestoneStep = stepName
			pcall(getgenv().ChilliHubLoadStep, stepName)
		end
	end

	local gameRef = game

	local function getService(serviceName)
		return gameRef:GetService(serviceName)
	end

	local Players = getService("Players")
	local ReplicatedStorage = getService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local RunService = getService("RunService")
	ctx.RunService = RunService
	local TeleportService = getService("TeleportService")
	local HttpService = getService("HttpService")
	local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	ctx.localPlayer = localPlayer
	local networking = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Networking")
	ctx.networking = networking
	local vector3New = Vector3.new
	ctx.vector3New = vector3New
	local cFrameNew = CFrame.new
	ctx.cFrameNew = cFrameNew
	local vector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	ctx.vector = vector
	local heartbeat = ctx.RunService.Heartbeat
	local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

	if genv.ChilliHubSaeCleanup then
		pcall(genv.ChilliHubSaeCleanup)
	end

	local tempValue, connections, state2 = true, {}, {cleanup = {}, inDim = function()
		return false
	end}

	ctx.flag = tempValue
	ctx.state = state2

	local function trackConnection(event, input)
		local connection = event:Connect(input)
		connections[#connections + 1] = connection
		return connection
	end

	ctx.waitHeartbeat = function()
		return heartbeat:Wait()
	end

	local function createInstance(className, instance2)
		local instance = Instance.new(className)

	end

	local function clampValue3(amount)
		amount = tonumber(amount) or 0
		local _ = 0

		while (amount >= 1000) and (_ < #unitSuffixes) do
			amount, _ = amount / 1000, _ + 1
		end

		local text, tempValue2 = (_ == 0) and tostring(math.floor(amount))

		if text then
			tempValue2 = text
		else
			local stringFormat, isRecent = string.format, ((amount < 10) and "%.2f") or ((amount < 100) and "%.1f")
			tempValue2 = stringFormat(isRecent or "%.0f", amount)
		end

		return tempValue2 .. (unitSuffixes[_] or "")
	end

	end

	local function hasTimedOut()
		local now = os.clock()
		if (now - amount2) < 0.2 then
			local amount3Ref, tempValue2 = amount3, now - amount2
			return amount3Ref - tempValue2
		end
		local serverTimeNow = getServerTimeNow()
		amount2 = now
		now = ctx.callModule

		if now("Cycle", "IsNightPhase", serverTimeNow) then
			amount3 = 0
			return 0
		else
			local callModule = ctx.callModule
			if callModule("Wall", "IsSealed") then
				amount3 = 0
				return 0
			end
		end

		now = ctx.callModule
		local Cycle = now("Cycle", "NextResetTime", serverTimeNow)
		amount3 = (Cycle and ((Cycle - 10) - serverTimeNow)) or 99
		Cycle = amount3
		return Cycle
	end

	ctx.matchesCriteria = function(input, input2)
		if input.rar then
			if not (input.rar[input2.r]) then
				return false
			end
		end

		if input.sp then
			local fieldValue, fieldValue2, tempValue2 = input.sp, input2.n

			if fieldValue2 then
				tempValue2 = fieldValue2
			else
				local getDisplayName = ctx.getDisplayName
				tempValue2 = getDisplayName(input2.cat)
			end

			if not (fieldValue[tempValue2]) then
				return false
			end
		end

		if input.no then
			local fieldValue, fieldValue2, tempValue2 = input.no, input2.n

			if fieldValue2 then
				tempValue2 = fieldValue2
			else
				local getDisplayName = ctx.getDisplayName
				tempValue2 = getDisplayName(input2.cat)
			end

			if fieldValue[tempValue2] then
				return false
			end
		end

		if input2.v < (input.minV or 0) then
			return false
		elseif input.maxV then
			if input2.v >= input.maxV then
				return false
			end
		end

		if input.mut then
			if #input2.m == 0 then
				return input.mut.None == true
			end

			for _, item in ipairs(input2.m) do
				if input.mut[item] then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		return true
	end

	ctx.holdOnTreadmill = function(amount, callback, amountCore)
		local clock = ctx.state

		if clock.ready then
			local state = ctx.state
			state.ready(callback)
		end

		amountCore = amountCore or (doStep2() * 0.92)
		clock = ctx.getRootPart

			if clockResult then
				clock = ctx.getRiftPosition

				if (amount - clock()).Magnitude < 30 then
					local state = ctx.state
					state.hideTread(((amount - clockResult.Position).Magnitude / amountCore) + 2)
				end
			end
		end

		clock, clockResult = os.clock, 1 / 0
		local now2, tempValueCore, factor = clock(), false, 0.016666666666666666

		while callback() do
			stateCore = ctx.getRootPart
			clock = stateCore()
			if not clock then
				return false
			end

			if clock.Anchored then
				if not (ctx.waitRootAnchored(callback)) then
					return false
				end
			end

			local tempValue2 = amount - clock.Position

			if tempValue2.Magnitude < 3 then
				local teleportRoot, cFrameNewCore = ctx.teleportRoot, ctx.cFrameNew
				teleportRoot(cFrameNewCore(amount) * clock.CFrame.Rotation)
				return true
			end

			if tempValue2.Magnitude < (clockResult - 3) then
				clockResult, now2 = tempValue2.Magnitude, os.clock()
			else
				local state, respawn = (os.clock() - now2) > 4

					local state3 = ctx.state
					respawn = state3.respawn
				else
					respawn = state
				end

				if respawn then
					state = ctx.state

					if state.inDim() then
						return false
					else
						local state3, timestamp = ctx.state, os.clock() - (ctx.state.respawnAt or -99)
						if timestamp < 10 then
							return false
						end
					end

					local setStatus = ctx.setStatus
					setStatus("Stuck in place, resetting the character")
					setStatus = ctx.state
					setStatus.respawn()
					return false
				elseif (os.clock() - now2) > 1 then
					if tempValueCore then
					else
						local invokeServer = ctx.invokeServer
						invokeServer("RF/Treadmill/AskDoff")
						invokeServer = ctx.state

							local teleportRoot, cFrameNewCore, getRiftPosition = ctx.teleportRoot, ctx.cFrameNew, ctx.getRiftPosition
							teleportRoot(cFrameNewCore(getRiftPosition() + ctx.vector3New(0, 3, 0)))
						end

						tempValueCore = true
					end
				else
				end
			end

			local teleportRootCore, cFrameNew2 = ctx.teleportRoot, ctx.cFrameNew
			teleportRootCore(cFrameNew2(clock.Position + (tempValue2.Unit * math.min(amountCore * factor,
				tempValue2.Magnitude))) * clock.CFrame.Rotation)
			cFrameNew2 = nil

		end

	end

	local function hasTimedOutCore(data, callback, callbackCore, input, inputCore)
		local now2 = ctx.state

		if now2.ready then
			local state = ctx.state
			state.ready(callback)
		end

		local timestamp, clock, startTime = os.clock() + (input or 30), os.clock, 1 / 0
		now2, input = clock(), 1

		while callback() and (os.clock() < timestamp) do
			clock = ctx.getRootPart
			local clockResult = clock()
			if not (clockResult) then
				return false
			end

			if clockResult.Anchored then
				if not (ctx.waitRootAnchored(callback)) then
					return false
				end
			end

			local unit = ctx.vector3New
			local unitResult = unit(data.X - clockResult.Position.X, 0, data.Z - clockResult.Position.Z)

			if unitResult.Magnitude <= (callbackCore or 6) then
				unit = ctx.vector
				clockResult.AssemblyLinearVelocity = unit
				return true
			end

			if clockResult.Anchored then
				ctx.waitRootAnchored(callback)
			end

			if unitResult.Magnitude < (startTime - 5) then

	local function scanItems2(data)
		local ipairsFn = ipairs

		for index, humanoidStateType in ipairsFn(humanoidStateTypes) do
			local pcallFn, setStateEnabled, hubSettings = pcall, data.SetStateEnabled, ctx.hubSettings
			local god, god2 = hubSettings.god

			if god then
				god2 = god
			else
				index = ctx.state
				god2 = index.godHunt
			end

			pcallFn(setStateEnabled, data, humanoidStateType, not god2)
		end

		ipairsFn = ctx.hubSettings

		if ipairsFn.god then
			if data.Health > 0 then
				if data.Health < data.MaxHealth then
					data.Health = data.MaxHealth
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function teleportTo()
		local state = ctx.state
		local invisBusy, invisBusy2 = state.invisBusy

		if invisBusy then
			invisBusy2 = invisBusy
		else
			state = ctx.hubSettings
			local tempValueSwap, steal = state.moveTo == "Teleport"

			if tempValueSwap then
				local hubSettings = ctx.hubSettings
				steal = hubSettings.steal
			else
				steal = tempValueSwap
			end

			if steal then
				tempValueSwap = ctx.state
				invisBusy2 = not tempValueSwap.tpFT
			else
				invisBusy2 = steal
			end
		end

		invisBusy = nil

		if invisBusy2 then
			invisBusy = invisBusy2
		else
			state = ctx.state
			local tempValueSwap = state.realHum ~= nil

			if tempValueSwap then
				local stateSwap = ctx.state
				invisBusy = stateSwap.realHum()
			else
				invisBusy = tempValueSwap
			end
		end

		return invisBusy
	end

	ctx.state.ready = function(callback, callbackSwap)
		local timestamp = os.clock() + (callbackSwap or 1.5)

		while true do
			callbackSwap = ctx.isRigAttached
			local callbackSwapResult = callbackSwap()
			if not (((if callbackSwapResult then not callbackSwapResult else not teleportTo())
				and (os.clock() < timestamp)) and callback()) then
				break
			end
			getHumanoid()
			callbackSwapResult = ctx.isRigAttached
			if callbackSwapResult() then
				return true
			end
			callbackSwapResult = ctx.waitHeartbeat
			callbackSwapResult()
		end

		return true
	end

		local classNames = {"LuaSourceContainer", "Sound", "ForceField", "JointInstance", "Constraint",
			"WeldConstraint", "BodyMover", "ProximityPrompt", "BillboardGui"}

		local function collectDescendants(callback, parent)
			local descendantMap = {}

			for _, descendant in ipairs(callback:GetDescendants()) do
				descendantMap[descendant] = descendant.Archivable
				descendant.Archivable = true
			end

			local archivable = callback.Archivable
			callback.Archivable = true
			local callResult, result = pcall(callback.Clone, callback)
			callback.Archivable = archivable

			for key, value in next, descendantMap, nil do
				pcall(function()
					key.Archivable = value
				end)
			end

			if callResult then
				if not (result) then
					return
				end
			else
				return
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(result:GetDescendants()) do
				archivable = false

				for _, className in ipairs(classNames) do
					archivable = archivable or (descendant:IsA(className))
				end

				if archivable then
					pcall(descendant.Destroy, descendant)
				elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
					descendant.Anchored = true
					descendant.CanCollide = false
					descendant.CanQuery = false
					descendant.CanTouch = false
				elseif descendant:IsA("Humanoid") then
					descendant.DisplayDistanceType, descendant.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None, Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
				end
			end

			result.Parent = parent
			return result
		end

				dis.cam.CameraType = dis.type
			end)

			for _, copy in ipairs(dis.copies) do
				pcall(copy.Destroy, copy)
			end
		end

			function state3.FormatRate(amount)
				amount = tonumber(amount) or 0

				if amount >= 1000000000000 then
					return string.format("%.2fT/s", amount / 1000000000000)
				elseif amount >= 1000000000 then
					return string.format("%.2fB/s", amount / 1000000000)
				elseif amount >= 1000000 then
					return string.format("%.2fM/s", amount / 1000000)
				elseif amount >= 1000 then
					return string.format("%.1fK/s", amount / 1000)
				end

				return string.format("%d/s", math.floor(amount))
			end

			function state3.FormatWeight(threshold)
				threshold = tonumber(threshold) or 0
				local isRecent = ((threshold >= 1000) and string.format("%.0f", threshold)) or string.format("%.2f",
					threshold)
				local match, tempValuePred = string.match(isRecent, "^(%-?%d+)(%.%d+)$")
				local match2 = match or isRecent

				while true do
					match, isRecent = string.gsub(match2, "^(%-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
					if isRecent == 0 then
						match2 = match
						break
					end
					match2 = match
				end

				return match2 .. ((tempValuePred or "") .. " Kg")
			end

			function state3.FormatClock(input)
				local computed = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(input) or 0))
				return string.format("%02dh %02dm %02ds", math.floor(computed / 3600), math.floor((computed % 3600) / 60),
					computed % 60)
			end

	local function doStep22(input, inputHop)
		local entry = ({Biggest = "s", ["Best rarity"] = "r"})[inputHop] or "v"

		table.sort(input, function(input2, input3)
			if inputHop == "Smallest" then
				return input2.s < input3.s
			end

			if input2[entry] ~= input3[entry] then
				return input2[entry] > input3[entry]
			end
			return input2.v > input3.v
		end)

		return input
	end

		local function collectChildren()
			local getPlotFolder = ctx.getPlotFolder
			local fieldValue2Result, vectorFarm, nextFn, cache, state3 = getPlotFolder(), ctx.vector, next, {}, ctx.state
			cache[1], cache[2] = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlacedEggRenders"), state3.hidden
			getPlotFolder = 0

			for index, item in nextFn, cache, nil do
				state3, index = ipairs, table.pack(item:GetChildren())

				for indexFarm, itemFarm in state3(table.unpack(index, 1, index.n)) do
					if itemFarm:IsA("Model") then
						indexFarm, item = ctx.localPlayer, itemFarm.Name:find(ctx.localPlayer.UserId .. "_", 1, true)

						if item == 1 then
							local tempValueFarm, tempValue2 = getPlotFolder + 1, vectorFarm + itemFarm:GetPivot().Position
							getPlotFolder, vectorFarm = tempValueFarm, tempValue2
						else
						end
					else
					end
				end
			end

			if getPlotFolder > 0 then
				return vectorFarm / getPlotFolder
			end
			return (fieldValue2Result and fieldValue2Result.PetArea) and fieldValue2Result.PetArea.Position
		end

		local function scanTableFarm(items)
			local tempValueFarm = ctx.getPlotFolder()

			if tempValueFarm then
				local petArea = tempValueFarm.PetArea
				local centerPoint = tempValueFarm.CenterPoint

				if petArea and centerPoint then
					local huge = math.huge
					local tempValue2 = -math.huge
					local huge2 = math.huge
					local tempValue5 = -math.huge
					local amount = 0

					for _, item in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
						for _, itemFarm in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
							local vector2 = centerPoint.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(petArea.CFrame * ctx.vector3New(item * petArea.Size.X / 2,
								petArea.Size.Y / 2, itemFarm * petArea.Size.Z / 2))
							amount = vector2.Y
							huge = math.min(huge, vector2.X)
							tempValue2 = math.max(tempValue2, vector2.X)
							huge2 = math.min(huge2, vector2.Z)
							tempValue5 = math.max(tempValue5, vector2.Z)
						end
					end

					local vector2s = {}

					for _, value in pairs(items) do
						local placement = type(value) == "table" and value.Placement
						local localCFrame = type(placement) == "table" and placement.LocalCFrame

						if typeof(localCFrame) == "CFrame" then
							vector2s[#vector2s + 1] = Vector2.new(localCFrame.X, localCFrame.Z)
						end
					end

					local itemsFarm = {}
					local vector2 = Vector2.new((huge + tempValue2) / 2, (huge2 + tempValue5) / 2)

					for index = math.ceil((huge + 2.5) / 4) * 4, tempValue2 - 2.5, 4 do
						for indexFarm = math.ceil((huge2 + 2.5) / 4) * 4, tempValue5 - 2.5, 4 do
							local vector22 = Vector2.new(index, indexFarm)
							local tempValue6 = true

							for _, vector23 in ipairs(vector2s) do
								if (vector23 - vector22).Magnitude < 3.9 then
									tempValue6 = false
									break
								end
							end

							if tempValue6 then
								local nextIndex = #itemsFarm + 1
								local magnitude = (vector22 - vector2).Magnitude
								itemsFarm[nextIndex] = { ctx.cFrameNew(index, amount, indexFarm), magnitude }
							end
						end
					end

					local function isValue(input, inputFarm)
						return input[2] < inputFarm[2]
					end

					table.sort(itemsFarm, isValue)
					return itemsFarm
				end
			end

			return {}
		end

		local function collectChildrenFarm(input)
			local callModule = ctx.callModule
			if callModule("Egg", "WearEggTool", input) == false then
				return false
			end
			callModule = os.clock() + 2

			while os.clock() < callModule do
				if readAttributeHop() == input then
					return true
				end

				if os.clock() > (callModule - 1.3) then
					local ipairsFn, children = ipairs, (doStep4() and doStep4():GetChildren()) or {}

					for _, child in ipairsFn(children) do
						if child:GetAttribute("UID") == input then
							local getHumanoidFarm, getHumanoid2 = ctx.getHumanoid, ctx.getHumanoid
							pcall(ctx.getHumanoid().EquipTool, ctx.getHumanoid(), child)
						end
					end
				end

				task.wait(0.1)
			end

			return false
		end

		local function hasTimedOutFarm()
			local hubSettings2 = ctx.hubSettings
			local placeWhen = hubSettings2.placeWhen

			if placeWhen == "Steal is idle" then
				hubSettings2 = ctx.hubSettings
				local steal = hubSettings2.steal
				return if steal then doStep9ResultSwap.empty ~= nil else not steal
			end

			if placeWhen == "Right after a steal" then
				hubSettings2 = os.clock() - startTime
				return hubSettings2 < 12
			end

			if placeWhen == "Only at night" then
				return hasTimedOut() < 14
			end
			return true
		end

		local function doStepFarm()
			local tryCall2Result, numVals, numVals2, hubSettings2 = tryCall2(), {}, {}, ctx.hubSettings
			local placeIdx, placeIdx2 = hubSettings2.placeIdx

			if placeIdx then
				hubSettings2 = ctx.state
				placeIdx2 = hubSettings2.indexMissing()
			else
				placeIdx2 = placeIdx
			end

			local placeIdx3, assetCategoryMap, amount = placeIdx2 or {}, {}, 0

			for _, value in pairs(tryCall2Result) do
				if type(value) == "table" then
					if value.Placement then
						placeIdx2 = amount + 1
						assetCategoryMap[(value.AssetCategory or value.Category) or ""] = true
						amount = placeIdx2
					else
					end
				else
				end
			end

			placeIdx = pairs

			for index, item in placeIdx(tryCall2Result) do
				if type(item) == "table" then
					if not (item.Placement) then
						if (doStep9ResultFarm.bad[index] or 0) < os.clock() then
							placeIdx2 = ctx.state

							if not (placeIdx2.reserved[index]) then
								hubSettings2 = ctx.state

								if not (hubSettings2.protect(index, item)) then
									local numVal = toNumberOrDefault2(item)
									numVal.uid = index

									if placeIdx3[numVal.cat] and not assetCategoryMap[numVal.cat] then
										assetCategoryMap[numVal.cat] = true
										numVals2[#numVals2 + 1] = numVal
									else
										local hubSettings3 = ctx.hubSettings

										if hubSettings3.place then
											local matchesCriteria = ctx.matchesCriteria

											if matchesCriteria(state, numVal) then
												numVals[#numVals + 1] = numVal
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			placeIdx2 = ctx.peekSave
			local placeIdx2Result, count = placeIdx2(), 0

			for value in next, ((placeIdx2Result and (type(placeIdx2Result.EquippedAssets) == "table")) and placeIdx2Result.EquippedAssets)
				or {}, nil do
				count += 1
			end

			placeIdx = 0

			for _, value in pairs(tryCall2Result) do
				placeIdx = if type(value) == "table" then if value.Placement then placeIdx else placeIdx + 1 else placeIdx
			end

			assetCategoryMap, hubSettings2 = pcall(function()
				local modules = ctx.modules
				return modules.Bases.GetAssetEquipCapacity((placeIdx2Result
					and tonumber(placeIdx2Result.BaseUpgradeLevel)) or 0)
			end)

			pen(("Eggs placed %d/%d  -  %d/%d pets equipped, %d in bag"):format(amount, 30, count, (assetCategoryMap and tonumber(hubSettings2)) or 0, placeIdx))
			return amount, numVals, tryCall2Result, numVals2
		end

		local doStep9Result2 = doStep9({name = "PlaceInfo", gap = 2, info = true})

		doStep9Result2.on = function()
			return getOpen("Farm")
		end

		doStep9Result2.fn = doStepFarm

		doStep9ResultFarm.want = function()
			local doStepFarmResult, tempValueFarm, tempValue2, tempValue5 = doStepFarm()

			if doStepFarmResult >= 30 then
				return
			elseif (#tempValueFarm + #tempValue5) == 0 then
				return
			elseif #tempValue5 == 0 then
				if not (hasTimedOutFarm()) then
					return
				end
			end

			local hubSettings2 = ctx.hubSettings

			if hubSettings2.placeFirst ~= "Backpack" then
				local hubSettings3 = ctx.hubSettings
				doStep22(tempValueFarm, hubSettings3.placeFirst)
			end

			for index, item in ipairs(tempValue5) do
				table.insert(tempValueFarm, index, item)
			end

			return {list = tempValueFarm, room = 30 - doStepFarmResult, recs = tempValue2}
		end

		doStep9ResultFarm.run = function(items, callback)
			local children = collectChildren()
			if not (children) then
				return
			end
			local setStatus = ctx.setStatus
			setStatus("Walking to your pen")
			setStatus = ctx.vector3New
			if not (checkState4(children + setStatus(0, 3, 0), callback)) then
				return
			end
			local scanTableFarmResult, computed, count, countFarm = scanTableFarm(items.recs), math.min(items.room,
				#items.list), 0, 0

			for index = 1, computed, 1 do
				if not (callback()) then
					break
				end
				setStatus = items.list[index]

				if collectChildrenFarm(setStatus.uid) then
					children = false

					for indexFarm = 1, 8, 1 do
						count += 1
						indexFarm = scanTableFarmResult[count]
						if not indexFarm then
							break
						end
						index = ctx.tryInvokeServer

						if index("RF/EggWorld/AskPlaceEgg", {Uid = setStatus.uid, LocalCFrame = indexFarm[1]}) then
							countFarm += 1
							local fieldValue = ctx.fieldValue
							fieldValue.placed = fieldValue.placed + 1
							children = true
							break
						end
					end

					if not children then
						doStep9ResultFarm.bad[setStatus.uid] = os.clock() + 60
					end

					task.wait(0.25)
				else
					doStep9ResultFarm.bad[setStatus.uid] = os.clock() + 20
				end
			end

			setStatus = ctx.callModule
			setStatus("Egg", "DoffEggTool")

			if countFarm > 0 then
				callback = ctx.setStatus
				callback("Placed " .. (countFarm .. " egg(s)"), "ok")
			end
		end

		doStep9ResultFarm.on = function()
			local hubSettings2 = ctx.hubSettings
			local place, place2 = hubSettings2.place

			if place then
				place2 = place
			else
				hubSettings2 = ctx.hubSettings
				place2 = hubSettings2.placeIdx
			end

			return place2
		end
	end)

		local function scanItems4(input, callback)

						task.wait(0.2)
					end

					doStep21Result = doStep21ResultRef
				else
				end
			end

			if not (doStep21Result) then
				doStep9ResultFarm.bad[input.uid .. input.k] = os.clock() + 30
				return mst(input.n .. " is not in your pen")
			end
			state3 = ctx.state
			if not (state3.needBody()) then
				return mst("Turning visible to use " .. labelMap3[input.k])
			end
			mst("Mutating " .. (input.n .. (" with " .. labelMap3[input.k])))
			uid = ctx.setStatus
			uid("Mutating " .. input.n)
			uid, state3 = ctx.vector3New, doStep21Result:GetPivot().Position + ctx.vector3New(0, 3, 4)
			if not (checkState4(state3, callback)) then
				return
			end
			state3 = ctx.getHumanoid
			callback = state3()

			if callback then
				pcall(callback.EquipTool, callback, input.tool)
			end

			state3 = ctx.localPlayer

			if input.tool.Parent ~= state3.Character then
				pcall(function()
					local tempValueFarm
					tempValueFarm, input.tool.Parent = ctx.localPlayer, ctx.localPlayer.Character
				end)
			end

			task.wait(0.3)
			local now2, invokeServer = os.clock(), ctx.invokeServer
			local AskUseMutationConsumable, tempValue2 = invokeServer("RF/BossMastery/AskUseMutationConsumable",
				input.uid)

			if (AskUseMutationConsumable and (type(tempValue2) == "table")) and tempValue2.Success then
				if tempValue2.Mutated then
					mst(input.n .. (" got " .. labelMap3[input.k]))
					doStep6("Mutated", input.n .. (" got " .. labelMap3[input.k]), "ok")
				else
					mst(("%s roll missed on %s (%s%% chance)"):format(labelMap3[input.k], input.n,
						tostring(valueMap[input.k] or "?")))
				end
			else
				doStep9ResultFarm.bad[input.uid .. input.k] = os.clock() + 600
				mst(("%s refused on %s: %s"):format(labelMap3[input.k], input.n,
					((type(tempValue2) == "table") and tostring(tempValue2.Message or "no reason")) or "no answer"))
			end

			task.wait(math.max(0, 1 - (os.clock() - now2)))

			if callback then
				pcall(callback.UnequipTools, callback)
			end

			return true
		end

	ctx.scanInventory = function(firstValue, input)
		local scanTable7Result, attributeHop, numVals, numVals2 = scanTable7(firstValue), readAttributeHop(), {}, {}

		for key, value in next, ((type(firstValue.Inventory) == "table") and firstValue.Inventory) or {}, nil do
			if type(value) == "table" then
				if not (value.InFuse) then
					if not (value.IsFavorite) then
						if not (scanTable7Result[key]) then
							local numVal = toNumberOrDefault2(value)
							numVal.uid = key
							numVals[#numVals + 1] = numVal
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		firstValue, scanTable7Result = pairs, (input and {}) or tryCall2()

		for index, item in firstValue(scanTable7Result) do
			if type(item) == "table" then
				if not (item.Placement) then
					if index ~= attributeHop then
						input = ctx.state

						if not (input.reserved[index]) then
							local state = ctx.state

							if not (state.protect(index, item)) then
								local numVal = toNumberOrDefault2(item)
								numVal.uid = index
								numVals2[#numVals2 + 1] = numVal
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return numVals, numVals2
	end

		local function scanItemsFarm(input, inputFarm, keyName)
			local uids, ipairsFn = {}, ipairs

			for index, item in ipairsFn(input) do
				local isRecent, isRecentFarm = item.r <= (inputFarm.mx or 0), ((inputFarm.v or 0) > 0)
					and (item.v < inputFarm.v)
				index = ((((inputFarm.rule == "Value Only") and isRecentFarm) or (((inputFarm.rule == "Rarity And Value") and isRecent) and isRecentFarm)) or ((inputFarm.rule == "Rarity Or Value") and (isRecent or isRecentFarm)))
					or ((inputFarm.rule == "Rarity Only") and isRecent)

				if index then
					if not (inputFarm.no and inputFarm.no[item.n]) then
						isRecent = ctx.hubSettings

						if isRecent[keyName] then
							if not (#item.m > 0) then
								uids[#uids + 1] = item.uid
							end
						else
							uids[#uids + 1] = item.uid
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return uids
		end

		local function scanItems3(input)
			local peekSave = ctx.peekSave
			local result2 = peekSave()
			if not (result2) then
				return 0, 0
			end
			peekSave = ctx.scanInventory
			local resultResult, ipairsRef = peekSave(result2)
			local scanItemsFarmResult, scanItemsFarmResultFarm = scanItemsFarm(resultResult, Pet,
				"sellPetsKeep"), scanItemsFarm(ipairsRef, Egg, "sellEggsKeep")
			local length = #scanItemsFarmResult
			local lengthFarm, count = #scanItemsFarmResultFarm, 0

			for _, item in ipairs(ipairsRef) do
				if cache[item.cat] and table.find(scanItemsFarmResultFarm, item.uid) then
					count += 1
				else
				end
			end

			local amount, amountFarm, AssetItems = 0, 0
			resultResult = tryCall2()

			pcall(function()
				AssetItems = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.AssetItems)
			end)

			for index, item in ipairs(scanItemsFarmResult) do
				index = result2.Inventory[item]
				item, peekSave = pcall(AssetItems.SalePrice, index)
				amount += (item and tonumber(peekSave)) or (toNumberOrDefault2(index).v * 100)
			end

			ipairsRef = ipairs

			for index, item in ipairsRef(scanItemsFarmResultFarm) do
				index, peekSave, result2 = ctx.modules, pcall(ctx.modules.Rec.SellPrice, resultResult[item])
				amountFarm += (peekSave and tonumber(result2)) or 0
			end

			local function formatCompact(amount4)
				local unitSuffixes2 = {"", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi"}
				local bestValue = 1

				while (math.abs(amount4) >= 1000) and (bestValue < #unitSuffixes2) do
					amount4, bestValue = amount4 / 1000, bestValue + 1
				end

				return (((bestValue == 1) and "$%.0f%s") or "$%.2f%s"):format(amount4, unitSuffixes2[bestValue])
			end

			doStep5("sellTx", function()
				tempValue6:Set(("Pet matches  -  %d pets for %s"):format(length, formatCompact(amount)))
				tempValue7:Set(("Egg matches  -  %d eggs (%d Halloween) for %s"):format(lengthFarm, count, formatCompact(amountFarm)))
			end)

			if input then
				if input == "pets" then
					scanItemsFarmResultFarm = {}
				else
					scanItemsFarmResult = {}
				end
			else
				resultResult, ipairsRef = ctx.hubSettings, ctx.hubSettings
				scanItemsFarmResult, scanItemsFarmResultFarm = if resultResult.sellPets then scanItemsFarmResult else {}, if ipairsRef.sellEggs then scanItemsFarmResultFarm else {}
			end

			for index = 1, math.max(#scanItemsFarmResult, #scanItemsFarmResultFarm), 50 do
				fireServer2("RE/PetSatchel/SellSelection", {Eggs = {table.unpack(scanItemsFarmResultFarm, index,
					math.min(index + 49,
					#scanItemsFarmResultFarm))}, Assets = {table.unpack(scanItemsFarmResult, index, math.min(index + 49, #scanItemsFarmResult))}})
				task.wait(0.3)
			end

			return #scanItemsFarmResult, #scanItemsFarmResultFarm
		end

		end

			local function scanItemsEggs(threshold, amount4)
				local keypoints = threshold.Keypoints
				if amount4 <= keypoints[1].Time then
					return keypoints[1].Value
				end

				for index = 2, #keypoints, 1 do
					local keypoint, keypoint2 = keypoints[index - 1], keypoints[index]

					if amount4 <= keypoint2.Time then
						threshold = keypoint2.Time - keypoint.Time
						index = ((threshold > 0) and ((amount4 - keypoint.Time) / threshold)) or 0
						return keypoint.Value:Lerp(keypoint2.Value, index)
					end
				end

				return keypoints[#keypoints].Value
			end

			local function scanTableEggs(data, amount4, amount5)

						end
					end
				end

				table.insert(keypoints, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, scanItemsEggs(data, amount5)))

			local function toNumberOrDefault3(threshold)

				result = ((type(callResult) == "table") and callResult[tostring(data.AssetCategory)]) or nil

				if type(result) == "table" then
					if type(result.Egg) == "table" then
						if result.Egg.Icon then
							return tostring(result.Egg.Icon)
						end
					end
				end

				return dataEggs.Icon or ""
			end

			local function tryCall4()
				local eggState = fieldValueEggs.EggState

				if type(eggState) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				elseif type(eggState.ReadOwnerEggs) ~= "function" then
					return nil
				end

				local callResult, result = pcall(eggState.ReadOwnerEggs, localPlayerEggs.UserId)

				if callResult then
					if type(result) ~= "table" then
						return nil
					end
				else
					return nil
				end

				local eggRecords, serverTime, oks = fieldValueEggs.EggRecords, workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), {}

				for key, value in pairs(result) do
					if type(value) == "table" then
						local assetCategory, number, mutations, amount4 = fieldValue.AssetInfo(value.AssetCategory), tonumber(value.AssetScale)
							or 0, ((type(value.Mutations) == "table") and value.Mutations) or {}, 0

						if type(eggRecords) == "table" then
							if type(eggRecords.WeightKg) == "function" then
								local ok2, result2 = pcall(eggRecords.WeightKg, value)
								amount4 = if ok2 then if type(result2) == "number" then result2 else amount4 else amount4
							else
							end
						else
						end

						callResult = {Id = key, Info = assetCategory, Scale = number, Weight = amount4, Mutations = mutations,
							Income = fieldValue.Income(assetCategory, number,
							mutations), Status = "Inventory", Remaining = 1 / 0, Percent = 0, EggIcon = tryCall3(value, assetCategory)}

						if value.Placement ~= nil then
							mutations, number = pcall(eggState.IsReadyToHatch, key)

							if mutations and number then
								callResult.Status = "Ready"
								callResult.Remaining = 0
								callResult.Percent = 100
							elseif type(eggRecords) == "table" then
								if type(eggRecords.GrowthSecondsRemaining) == "function" then
									assetCategory = 1

									if type(eggRecords.GrowthSpeedMultiplier) == "function" then
										local ok2, result2 = pcall(eggRecords.GrowthSpeedMultiplier, value)
										assetCategory = if ok2 then if type(result2) == "number" then result2 else assetCategory else assetCategory
									else
									end

									local bestValueEggs, ok2, result2 = 0, pcall(eggRecords.GrowthSecondsRemaining, value, serverTime,
										assetCategory)
									local remaining = if ok2 then if type(result2) == "number" then result2 else 0 else 0

									if type(eggRecords.GrowthDuration) == "function" then
										result2, ok2 = pcall(eggRecords.GrowthDuration, value)
										bestValueEggs = if result2 then if type(ok2) == "number" then ok2 else bestValueEggs else bestValueEggs
									else
									end

									callResult.Status = "Growing"
									callResult.Remaining = remaining

									if bestValueEggs > 0 then
										callResult.Percent = math.clamp(math.floor((1 - (remaining / bestValueEggs)) * 100), 0, 100)
									end
								else
									callResult.Status = "Growing"
								end
							else
								callResult.Status = "Growing"
							end
						end

						table.insert(oks, callResult)
					end
				end

				return oks
			end

			local function doStep12(input)

				table.sort(input, function(data, dataEggs)
					if (sort == nameList2[2]) and (data.Info.RarityNumber ~= dataEggs.Info.RarityNumber) then
						return data.Info.RarityNumber > dataEggs.Info.RarityNumber
					elseif sort == nameList2[3] then
						if data.Remaining ~= dataEggs.Remaining then
							return data.Remaining < dataEggs.Remaining
						end
					end

					if data.Income ~= dataEggs.Income then
						return data.Income > dataEggs.Income
					end
					return tostring(data.Id) < tostring(dataEggs.Id)
				end)
			end

			local function scanTable3(data, input)
				if input == "" then
					return true
				end
				local text = (string.lower(tostring(data.Info.Name) .. (" " .. (tostring(data.Info.Rarity) .. (" " .. data.Status)))))

				for _, mutation in ipairs(data.Mutations) do
					text ..= " " .. string.lower(tostring(mutation))
				end

				return string.find(text, input, 1, true) ~= nil
			end

			local function scanTable4(value, input)
				if type(value) ~= "table" then
					return "", nil
				elseif #value == 0 then
					return "", nil
				end

				local parts2 = {}

				for _, item in ipairs(value) do
					table.insert(parts2, tryCall6(item))
				end

				local text = tostring(value[1])
				value = nil

				if text == "Rainbow" then
					value = colorSequence2
				else
					if text == "Prismatic" then
						value = colorSequence2
					else
						local colorPalette3 = state5[text] or colorPalette
						value = ColorSequence.new(colorPalette3[1], colorPalette3[2])
					end
				end

				return table.concat(parts2, input or " + "), value
			end

			local function checkState8(data)
				if data.Status == "Ready" then
					return "READY"
				elseif data.Status == "Growing" then
					if data.Remaining == (1 / 0) then
						return "GROWING"
					end
					return toNumberOrDefault3(data.Remaining) .. ("  " .. (data.Percent .. "%"))
				end

				return "IN BAG"
			end

			local function invokeServer(remoteName)
				local rfEggWorldAskHatch = networkingEggs:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskHatch")

				if rfEggWorldAskHatch then
					if not (rfEggWorldAskHatch:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then
						return false
					end
				else
					return false
				end

				local callResult, result = pcall(rfEggWorldAskHatch.InvokeServer, rfEggWorldAskHatch, remoteName)

				if callResult then
					if result == false then
						return false
					end
				else
					return false
				end

				task.wait(0.35)
				callResult = networkingEggs:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskFinishHatch")

				if callResult then
					if callResult:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
						pcall(callResult.InvokeServer, callResult, remoteName)
					end
				end

				return true
			end

			local tempValue10 = false

			local function runAction()
				local focus = tempValue7 and tempValue7.Focus

				if type(focus) ~= "table" then
					return
				elseif focus.Id == nil then
					return
				elseif tempValue10 then
					return
				end

				tempValue10 = true
				local text = tostring(focus.Id)

				pcall(function()
					if focus.Status == "Inventory" then
						local eggState = fieldValueEggs.EggState

						if type(eggState) == "table" then
							if type(eggState.WearEggTool) == "function" then
								if pcall(eggState.WearEggTool, text) then
									return
								end
							end
						end

						eggState = networkingEggs:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskWearTool")

						if eggState then
							if eggState:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
								pcall(eggState.InvokeServer, eggState, text)
							end
						end

						return
					end

					if focus.Status == "Ready" then
						invokeServer(text)
						return
					end
					local placedEggRenders = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlacedEggRenders")
					local tempValue8

					if placedEggRenders then
						local ipairsFn, children = ipairs, table.pack(placedEggRenders:GetChildren())

						for _, item in ipairsFn(table.unpack(children, 1, children.n)) do
							if string.find(item.Name, text, 1, true) or (item:GetAttribute("Uid") == text) then
								tempValue8 = item
								break
							end
						end
					else
					end

					if not tempValue8 then
						return
					end

					local callResult, result = pcall(function()
						return (tempValue8:IsA("Model") and tempValue8:GetPivot()) or tempValue8.CFrame
					end)

					if not (callResult) then
						return
					end
					position = result.Position
				end)

				tempValue10 = false
				requestEggRefresh()
			end

			local function clampValue5(width, unit, text)
				if width <= 0 then

				end

				computed2 = math.clamp(math.floor((computed3 + computed) / ((unit * 8.2) + computed)), 4, 6)

			local function refreshFuse()
				if not (tempValueEggs) then
					return
				end
				count = 2
				table.clear(list3)
				local countEggs, count2 = 0, 0

				local function registerItem(input, inputEggs)
					countEggs += 1
					local checkState9Result = checkState9(countEggs)
					checkState9Result.Set({Visible = true, Text = input})
					table.insert(list3, {Kind = "text", Handle = checkState9Result, Gap = inputEggs})
				end

				local function colorizeText(input, inputEggs)
					registerItem(string.format("<b><font color=\"%s\">%s</font></b>", inputEggs, input), #list3 > 0)
				end

				local tryCall4Result = tryCall4()

				if tryCall4Result then
					if tryCall4Result.Result then
						local result = tryCall4Result.Result
						local assetCategory, number, mutations = fieldValue.AssetInfo(result.AssetCategory), tonumber(result.AssetScale)
							or 1, ((type(result.Mutations) == "table") and result.Mutations) or {}
						doStep12(assetCategory, tryCall4Result)
						colorizeText("FUSE RESULT (CONFIRMED)", color.Ready)
						registerItem(paint(color.Hint, "Species") .. ("  " .. (bold(paint(assetCategory.Hex,
							"[" .. (string.upper(tostring(assetCategory.Rarity)) .. "]"))) .. (" " .. bold(paint(color.Text,
							fieldValue.Escape(assetCategory.Name)))))), false)
						local mutations2 = tryCallEggs(result.AssetCategory, number)
						registerItem(paint(color.Hint, "Size") .. ("  " .. (bold(paint(scanTableEggs(number),
							string.format("%.2fx", number))) .. ((mutations2 and (fieldValue.Separator() .. paint(color.Weight,
							fieldValue.FormatWeight(mutations2)))) or ""))), false)
						mutations2 = fieldValue.MutationText(mutations)
						registerItem(paint(color.Hint,
							"Mutation") .. ("  " .. (((mutations2 ~= "") and mutations2) or paint(color.Text, "Normal"))), false)
						registerItem(paint(color.Hint, "Income") .. ("  " .. bold(paint(color.Income,
							fieldValue.FormatRate(fieldValue.Income(assetCategory, number, mutations))))), false)
						registerItem(paint(color.Hint, "The server picks this egg when the fuse starts, it will not change"), false)
					else
						if #tryCall4Result.Items == 0 then
							doStep12(nil, nil)
							registerItem(bold(paint(color.Text, "Machine is empty")), false)
							registerItem(paint(color.Hint, "Load 3 pets of the same species to see the result odds"), false)

	local function readAttributePrio(instance)
		local tempValuePrio, pos = (kMap[getAttribute(instance)] ~= nil) or (instance:GetAttribute("IsBat") == true)

		if tempValuePrio then
			pos = tempValuePrio
		else
			local attribute = instance:GetAttribute("ItemType")
			pos = (if attribute then not attribute else not instance:GetAttribute("GearName"))
				and ((instance.Name:lower():find("bat") or instance.Name:lower():find("sword")) or instance.Name:lower():find("hammer"))
		end

		return pos
	end

	local function readGetAttribute(instance)

	end

	ctx.state.bat = function()
		local attributeMap, swapT, attributeEntries, localPlayerPrio = {}, ipairs, {}, ctx.localPlayer

		do
			local packedValues = table.pack(localPlayerPrio.Character or (doStep4()), doStep4())
			table.move(packedValues, 1, packedValues.n, 1, attributeEntries)
		end

		localPlayerPrio = nil
		local amount = -2

		for index, attributeEntry in swapT(attributeEntries) do
			local ipairsFn, children = ipairs, (attributeEntry and attributeEntry:GetChildren()) or {}

			for indexPrio, child in ipairsFn(children) do
				if child:IsA("Tool") then
					if readAttributePrio(child) then
						indexPrio, index = kMap[getAttribute(child)] or 0, ctx.hubSettings

						if index.weap then
							attributeEntry = ctx.hubSettings

							if attributeEntry.weap[getAttribute(child)] then
								if not (attributeMap[getAttribute(child)]) then
									attributeMap[getAttribute(child)] = child
								end
							end
						end

						if indexPrio >= 0 then
							if localPlayerPrio then
								if indexPrio > amount then
									localPlayerPrio, amount = child, indexPrio
								else
								end
							else
								localPlayerPrio, amount = child, indexPrio
							end
						else
						end
					else
					end
				else
				end
			end
		end

		attributeEntries = {}

		for _, item in ipairs(items5) do
			if attributeMap[item] then
				attributeEntries[#attributeEntries + 1] = attributeMap[item]
			end
		end

		if #attributeEntries == 0 then
			return localPlayerPrio, math.max(amount, 0)
		end

		if #attributeEntries > 1 then
			if valueMap.number > #attributeEntries then
				valueMap.number = 1
			end

			local tempValuePrio, timestamp, tempValue2, swapT2 = (valueMap.number % #attributeEntries) + 1, os.clock() - valueMap.at, valueMap.number == 2

			if tempValue2 then
				localPlayerPrio = ctx.hubSettings
				swapT2 = localPlayerPrio.swapT2
			else
				swapT2 = tempValue2
			end

			tempValue2 = nil

			if swapT2 then
				tempValue2 = swapT2
			else
				attributeMap = ctx.hubSettings
				tempValue2 = attributeMap.swapT
			end

			swapT2, swapT = timestamp >= (tempValue2 or 0.35)

			if swapT2 then
				swapT = swapT2
			else
				tempValue2 = readGetAttribute(attributeEntries[valueMap.number])
				swapT = if tempValue2 then not tempValue2 else readGetAttribute(attributeEntries[tempValuePrio])
			end

			if swapT then
				valueMap.number, valueMap.at = tempValuePrio, os.clock()
			end
		else
			valueMap.number = 1
		end

		swapT = attributeEntries[valueMap.number]
		return swapT, math.max(kMap[getAttribute(swapT)] or 0, 0)
	end

		local function runUntilTimeout(amount, callback)

				local teleportRootBloom, cFrameNew2, vector3New2 = ctx.teleportRoot, ctx.cFrameNew, ctx.vector3New
				teleportRootBloom(cFrameNew2(amount + vector3New2(0, 3, 4)))
