		end

		local function doStep14(callback)
			local NetStand = isPartBloom("NetStand") or isPartBloom("ButterflyMachine")
			if not (NetStand) then
				return false
			end
			local leaveFuse = ctx.leaveFuse
			if not (leaveFuse(callback)) then
				return false
			end
			leaveFuse = ctx.getRootPart
			local fieldValueResult = leaveFuse()

			if fieldValueResult then
				if (fieldValueResult.Position - NetStand).Magnitude > 60 then
					leaveFuse = ctx.state
					if not (leaveFuse.reach({Pos = NetStand, Name = "the net"}, callback)) then
						return false
					end
				end
			end

			for index = 1, 5, 1 do
				if not (callback()) then
					return false
				end
				runUntilTimeout(NetStand, callback)
				fieldValueResult = ctx.invokeServer
				index, leaveFuse = fieldValueResult("RF/Butterflies/AskClaimNet")

				if index then
					if leaveFuse == true then
						return true
					end
				end

				task.wait(0.8)
			end

			return doStep12().NetClaimed == true
		end

		end

		doStep9ResultBloom.run = function(value, input)
			local state = ctx.state
			if not (state.needBody()) then
				return
			end
			state = ctx.getHumanoid
			local humanoid = state()

			if not (doStep12().NetClaimed) then
				doStep13("Claiming the butterfly net")

				if ctx.waitRootAnchored(input) then

					end

					return doStep13("Could not claim the net")
				end
			end

			if position then
				position2 = position
			else

				position2 = (state(6700, 74, -364))
			end

			state = ctx.getRootPart
			position = state()

			if position and ((position.Position - position2).Magnitude > 300) then
				if os.clock() < startTime then
					return doStep13("Ragdoll TP did not land, trying again soon")
				end
				pcall(humanoid.UnequipTools, humanoid)

				if ctx.waitRootAnchored(input) then
					state = ctx.leaveFuse
					if not (state(input)) then
						return doStep13("Stuck on treadmill")
					end
				else
					return doStep13("Stuck on treadmill")
				end

				value = ctx.getRootPart
				position = value()

				if position then

					if isBeforeAreas(position.Position) then

							return
						end
					end
				end

				local vector3NewBloom = ctx.vector3New
				local raycastGroundResult, tempValueBloom = raycastGround(position2 + vector3NewBloom(0, 0, 6)), false

				for index = 1, 2, 1 do

						return raycastGroundResult
					end, input)

					if tempValueBloom then
						break
					elseif not (input()) then
						break
					end

					task.wait(0.5)
				end

				if tempValueBloom then
				else
					if input() then

						tempValueBloom = if vector3NewBloom.reach({Pos = raycastGroundResult, Name = "the bloom"},
							input) then true else tempValueBloom
					else
					end
				end

				if not (tempValueBloom) then
					startTime = os.clock() + 10
					return doStep13("Ragdoll TP did not land, trying again soon")

					for _, itemBloom in ipairs((((item ~= hubSettings)
						and item.Character) and item.Character:GetChildren()) or {}) do

							if itemBloom.CanCollide then
								itemBloom.CanCollide = false

					end

			while (input() and (readAttributeBloom())) and (hasTimedOut() > 0) do

					else

					end

		local function scanItemsBloom(data)
			local green, blue, purple, golden = data.Green or 0, data.Blue or 0, data.Purple or 0, data.Golden or 0

			for index = 60, 1, -1 do
				data = math.max(0, (index * valueMap4.Golden) - golden)
				local computed = math.max(0, ((index * valueMap4.Purple) + (valueMap3.Purple * data)) - purple)
				local computedBloom = math.max(0, ((index * valueMap4.Blue) + (valueMap3.Blue * computed)) - blue)
				if green >= ((index * valueMap4.Green) + (valueMap3.Green * computedBloom)) then
					return {Green = computedBloom, Blue = computed, Purple = data}
				end
			end
		end

		local function enterTree(callback)
			local parent = ctx.localPlayer
			if parent:GetAttribute("InEnchantedTree") then
				return true
			end
			parent = ctx.findWorldPart
			local Build = parent("Build", "EnchantedTreeInterior", "Markers", "EnterTrigger", "EnchantedTreeEntrance",
				"EnchantedTreePrompt")
			parent = Build and Build.Parent
			local worldPosition = parent
				and ((parent:IsA("Attachment") and parent.WorldPosition) or (parent:IsA("BasePart") and parent.Position))
			if not (worldPosition) then
				return false
			end
			parent = ctx.leaveFuse
			if not (parent(callback)) then
				return false
			end
			parent = ctx.getRootPart
			local parentResult = parent()

			if parentResult then
				parent = ctx.isBeforeAreas

				if parent(parentResult.Position) then
					local retryUntil = ctx.retryUntil
					if not (retryUntil(callback, "Enchanted Tree", 0.3)) then
						return false
					end
				end
			end

			parent = ctx.vector3New
			parentResult = worldPosition + parent(0, 0, -12)

			for index = 1, 2, 1 do
				parent = ctx.getRootPart
				index = parent()

				if index then
					if callback() then
						if hasTimedOut() > 0 then
							if not ((index.Position - parentResult).Magnitude > 500) then
								break
							end
						else
							break
						end
					else
						break
					end
				else
					break
				end

				index = ctx.setStatus
				index("Ragdoll TP to the Enchanted Tree")
				index = ctx.vector3New
				ragTo(parentResult + index(0, 3, 0), callback)
			end

			parent = ctx.getRootPart
			local parentResultBloom = parent()

			if parentResultBloom then
				if (parentResultBloom.Position - parentResult).Magnitude > 60 then
					parent = ctx.state
					if not (parent.reach({Pos = parentResult, Name = "the tree"}, callback)) then
						return false
					end
				end
			end

			for index = 1, 4, 1 do
				callback, parentResult, index = ctx.teleportRoot, ctx.cFrameNew, ctx.vector3New
				callback(parentResult(worldPosition + index(0, 3, -6)))
				pcall(fireproximityprompt, Build)
				parent = os.clock() + 4

				while true do
					parentResultBloom, index = os.clock() < parent

					if parentResultBloom then
						local localPlayerBloom = ctx.localPlayer
						index = not localPlayerBloom:GetAttribute("InEnchantedTree")
					else
						index = parentResultBloom
					end

					if not index then
						break
					end
					local waitHeartbeat = ctx.waitHeartbeat
					waitHeartbeat()
				end

				index = ctx.localPlayer
				if index:GetAttribute("InEnchantedTree") then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		tempValue10 = ctx.state
		tempValue10.enterTree = enterTree
		local state5 = ctx.state

		state5.leaveTree = function()
			local findWorldPart = ctx.findWorldPart
			local Build = findWorldPart("Build", "EnchantedTreeInterior", "Markers", "ExitTrigger")

			if Build then
				if Build:IsA("BasePart") then
					findWorldPart = ctx.localPlayer
					if not (findWorldPart:GetAttribute("InEnchantedTree")) then
						return
					end
				else
					return
				end
			else
				return
			end

			local teleportRoot, cFrameNewBloom = ctx.teleportRoot, ctx.cFrameNew
			teleportRoot(cFrameNewBloom(Build.Position + (Build.CFrame.LookVector * ((Build.Size.Z / 2) + 3))))
			teleportRoot = ctx.waitHeartbeat
			teleportRoot()
			findWorldPart = ctx.teleportRoot
			findWorldPart(Build.CFrame)
			findWorldPart = os.clock() + 1.5

			while true do
				cFrameNewBloom = ctx.localPlayer
				if not (cFrameNewBloom:GetAttribute("InEnchantedTree") and (os.clock() < findWorldPart)) then
					break
				end
				teleportRoot = ctx.waitHeartbeat
				teleportRoot()
			end

			findWorldPart = ctx.localPlayer

			if findWorldPart:GetAttribute("InEnchantedTree") then
				teleportRoot = ctx.getRootPart
				tryValue(teleportRoot(), Build)
			end
		end

		local function scanItems3(input, inputBloom, input2, ...)
			local isPartBloomResult = isPartBloom(inputBloom)
			if not (isPartBloomResult) then
				return false
			end

			for index = 1, 3, 1 do
				runUntilTimeout(isPartBloomResult, input2)
				index = ctx.invokeServer
				local indexResult, tempValueBloom, text = index(input, ...)

				if indexResult then
					if tempValueBloom ~= false then
						return true
					end
				end

				if not (tostring(text):lower():find("closer")) then
					return false
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		doStep9Result3.run = function(input, callback)
			input = ctx.state
			if not (input.needBody()) then
				return
			end

			if ctx.waitRootAnchored(callback) then
				if not (enterTree(callback)) then
					input = ctx.setStatus
					return input("Could not enter the tree", "warn")
				end
			else
				local setStatus = ctx.setStatus
				return setStatus("Could not enter the tree", "warn")
			end

			input = ctx.hubSettings
			local bfSmart, ipairsFnBloom = input.bfSmart and scanItemsBloom(doStep12().Counts or {}), ipairs
			input = (bfSmart and {"Green", "Blue", "Purple"}) or {}

			for index, item in ipairsFnBloom(input) do
				index = bfSmart[item]

				for indexBloom = 1, index, 1 do
					indexBloom = ctx.hubSettings

					if indexBloom.bfSmart then
						if callback() then
							if not (scanItems3("RF/Butterflies/AskTradeUp", "ButterflyMachine", callback, item)) then
								break
							end
						else
							break
						end
					else
						break
					end

					task.wait(0.15)
				end
			end

			bfSmart, ipairsFnBloom = ipairs, ctx.hubSettings
			input = (ipairsFnBloom.bfSmart and {}) or entries

			for index, item in bfSmart(input) do
				while true do
					index = ctx.hubSettings
					local count, tempValueBloom = (index.bfTrade and callback()) and (doStep12().Counts or {})[item]

					if count then
						ipairsFnBloom = nil
						ipairsFnBloom, tempValueBloom = ctx.hubSettings, (doStep12().Counts[item] - ((ctx.hubSettings.bfCraft
							and valueMap4[item]) or 0)) >= valueMap3[item]
					else
						tempValueBloom = count
					end

					if not tempValueBloom then
						break
					end

					if not (scanItems3("RF/Butterflies/AskTradeUp", "ButterflyMachine", callback, item)) then
						break
					end
					task.wait(0.15)
				end
			end

			for index = 1, 50, 1 do
				ipairsFnBloom = ctx.hubSettings

				if ipairsFnBloom.bfCraft then
					if callback() then
						if not (scanTableBloom(doStep12().Counts or {})) then
							break
						end
					else
						break
					end
				else
					break
				end

				if not (scanItems3("RF/Butterflies/AskCraftEssence", "MutationShrine", callback)) then
					break
				end
				task.wait(0.3)
			end

			callback = ctx.state
			callback.leaveTree()
		end
	end)

	runStep("31_bloom#2", function()
		local doStep9ResultBloom, butterflyBloom = doStep9({name = "Wisp", gap = 3}), cacheCore["Butterfly Bloom"]
		local getSetResult = getSet("wt", butterflyBloom:Text("Wisp Status", "Off"))

		doStep9ResultBloom.on = function()
			local hubSettings = ctx.hubSettings
			return hubSettings.wisp or getOpen("Event")
		end

		butterflyBloom = ctx.modules
		local wisp = butterflyBloom.Wisp

		local function doStepBloom()
			local peekSave = ctx.peekSave
			local wispCompanionResult = peekSave()
			peekSave = wispCompanionResult and wispCompanionResult.WispCompanion
			return wispCompanionResult, ((type(peekSave) == "table") and peekSave) or nil
		end

		local function checkStateBloom(data)
			if data then
				if data.Accepted then
					if data.Unlocked then
						return
					end
				else
					return
				end
			else
				return
			end

			return (((type(wisp) == "table") and wisp.List) or {})[tonumber(data.Stage) or 1]
		end

		local function toNumberOrDefault3(data, dataBloom)
			return ((type(data.Progress) == "table") and tonumber(data.Progress[dataBloom.Id])) or 0
		end

		local function isClaimed(data, dataBloom)
			return (type(data.Claimed) == "table") and data.Claimed[dataBloom.Id]
		end

		local cache = {}

		local function scanTableBloom(keyName)
			if not (cache[keyName]) then
				local entries = {}

				pcall(function()
					for _, item in ipairs(require(ReplicatedStorage.Data.Areas.Configs[keyName]).DropTable) do
						entries[tostring(item[1] or item.Category)] = true
					end
				end)

				cache[keyName] = entries
			end

			return cache[keyName]
		end

		local entriesBloom = {at = 0}

		local function hasTimedOutBloom(firstValue)
			if entriesBloom.q == firstValue then
				if (os.clock() - entriesBloom.at) < 2 then
					local entriesBloomRef = entriesBloom
					return entriesBloomRef
				end
			end

			local peekSave = ctx.peekSave
			local fieldValueResult, scanTableBloomResult = peekSave(), scanTableBloom((type(firstValue.Match) == "table")
				and firstValue.Match.AreaId)
			local scanTable7Result, cacheBloom, flag2Map = scanTable7(fieldValueResult or {}), {}, {}

			for key, value in next, ((fieldValueResult and (type(fieldValueResult.Inventory) == "table")) and fieldValueResult.Inventory)
				or {}, nil do
				peekSave = (type(value) == "table") and tostring(value.AssetCategory)

				if peekSave then
					if scanTableBloomResult[peekSave] then
						if not (value.IsFavorite) then
							if not (value.InFuse) then
								if not (scanTable7Result[key]) then
									cacheBloom[peekSave] = cacheBloom[peekSave] or {}
									table.insert(cacheBloom[peekSave], key)
									flag2Map[peekSave] = (flag2Map[peekSave] or 0) + 1
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			for _, value in pairs(tryCall2()) do
				fieldValueResult = (type(value) == "table") and tostring(value.AssetCategory)

				if fieldValueResult then
					if scanTableBloomResult[fieldValueResult] then
						flag2Map[fieldValueResult] = (flag2Map[fieldValueResult] or 0) + 1
					end
				end
			end

			entriesBloom = {q = firstValue, at = os.clock(), supply = 0}

			for key, value in next, cacheBloom, nil do
				if #value >= 3 then
					fieldValueResult, firstValue = entriesBloom, entriesBloom
					fieldValueResult.ready = {value[1], value[2], value[3]}
					firstValue.cat = key
				end
			end

			for _, value in next, flag2Map, nil do
				scanTableBloomResult = entriesBloom
				scanTableBloomResult.supply = math.max(entriesBloom.supply, value)
			end

			fieldValueResult = entriesBloom
			return fieldValueResult
		end

		local function checkState2(input)
			local doStepBloomResult, tempValueBloom = doStepBloom()
			local rarity = checkStateBloom(tempValueBloom)

			if rarity then
				if isClaimed(tempValueBloom, rarity) then
					return false
				end
			else
				return false
			end

			local match = ((type(rarity.Match) == "table") and rarity.Match) or {}
			if rarity.Event == "PetFused" then
				return (input.a == match.AreaId) and (hasTimedOutBloom(rarity).supply < 3)
			end

			if rarity.Event ~= "EggSecured" then
				return false
			elseif toNumberOrDefault3(tempValueBloom, rarity) >= (tonumber(rarity.Target) or 1) then
				return false
			end

			for key, value in next, match, nil do
				if key == "AreaId" then
					if value ~= input.a then
						return false
					end
				elseif key == "Rarity" then
					rarity = doStep3(input.cat)
					rarity = rarity and rarity.Rarity

					if rarity then
						if not (rarity.DisplayName == value) then
							if not (rarity._id == value) then
								return false
							end
						end
					else
						return false
					end
				else
					return false
				end
			end

			return true
		end

		local state = ctx.state

		state.wispSteals = function()

				return false
			end
			local doStepBloomResult, tempValueBloom = doStepBloom()
			hubSettings = checkStateBloom(tempValueBloom)

			if hubSettings then
				if isClaimed(tempValueBloom, hubSettings) then
					return false
				end
			else
				return false
			end

			if hubSettings.Event == "EggSecured" then
				return toNumberOrDefault3(tempValueBloom, hubSettings) < (tonumber(hubSettings.Target) or 1)
			end
			return (hubSettings.Event == "PetFused") and (hasTimedOutBloom(hubSettings).supply < 3)
		end

		butterflyBloom = ctx.state
		local wantEgg, stateBloom = butterflyBloom.wantEgg, ctx.state

		local function isPartBloom(...)
			local findWorldPart = ctx.findWorldPart
			local Build = findWorldPart("Build", ...)
			return Build
				and ((Build:IsA("BasePart") and Build.Position) or (Build:IsA("Model") and Build:GetPivot().Position))
		end

		local function scanItemsBloom(input)
			local peekSave = ctx.peekSave
			local fieldValueResult = peekSave()
			if not (fieldValueResult) then
				return
			end

			if fieldValueResult.FusionLocked then
				if type(fieldValueResult.FusionEggReward) == "table" then
					peekSave = ctx.invokeServer
					peekSave("RF/Fusery/FinishReveal")
				end

				return getSetResult("Fusing for the wisp quest")
			end

			peekSave = hasTimedOutBloom(input)
			if not (peekSave.ready) then
				return getSetResult(((peekSave.supply >= 3)
					and "Hatching eggs for the fuse quest") or "Stealing eggs for the fuse quest")
			end
			local cacheBloom, cache5 = {}, {}

			for _, item in ipairs(peekSave.ready) do
				cacheBloom[item] = true
			end

			local ipairsFn, fusionSlots = ipairs, ((type(fieldValueResult.FusionSlots) == "table") and fieldValueResult.FusionSlots) or {}

			for _, fusionSlot in ipairsFn(fusionSlots) do
				if cacheBloom[fusionSlot] then
					cache5[fusionSlot] = true
				else
					input = ctx.invokeServer
					input("RF/Fusery/EjectPet", fusionSlot)
					task.wait(0.35)
				end
			end

			if fieldValueResult.FusionInfoAcknowledged == false then
				ipairsFn = ctx.invokeServer
				ipairsFn("RF/Fusery/ConfirmBriefing")
				task.wait(0.35)
			end

			ipairsFn, input = ipairs, peekSave.ready

			for index, item in ipairsFn(input) do
				if not (cache5[item]) then
					index = ctx.invokeServer
					index("RF/Fusery/LoadPet", item)
					task.wait(0.35)
				end
			end

			ipairsFn = ctx.invokeServer
			ipairsFn("RF/Fusery/BeginFuse")
			entriesBloom.at = 0
			cache5 = ctx.getDisplayName
			getSetResult("Fusing 3 " .. (cache5(peekSave.cat) .. " for the wisp quest"))
		end

		doStep9ResultBloom.fn = function()
			local doStepBloomResult, tempValueBloom = doStepBloom()
			if not (tempValueBloom) then
				return getSetResult("Reading quest")
			end
			local tempValue2 = ((type(wisp) == "table") and tonumber(wisp.StageCount)) or 4
			if tempValueBloom.Unlocked then
				scanTable2("wst", nostat, {Stage = ("%d / %d"):format(tempValue2, tempValue2), Progress = "Complete"})
				return getSetResult("Done, the Enchanted Tree is open")
			end

			if not (tempValueBloom.Accepted) then
				scanTable2("wst", nostat, {Stage = ("0 / %d"):format(tempValue2), Progress = "Not accepted"})
			end

			local checkStateBloomResult = checkStateBloom(tempValueBloom)

			if checkStateBloomResult then
				scanTable2("wst", nostat, {Stage = ("%d / %d"):format(tonumber(tempValueBloom.Stage) or 1, tempValue2),
					Progress = ("%d / %d"):format(toNumberOrDefault3(tempValueBloom, checkStateBloomResult),
					tonumber(checkStateBloomResult.Target) or 1)})
			end

			checkStateBloomResult = ctx.hubSettings
			if not (checkStateBloomResult.wisp) then
				return getSetResult("Off")
			end

			if doStepBloomResult.FusionLocked then
				if type(doStepBloomResult.FusionEggReward) == "table" then
					checkStateBloomResult = ctx.invokeServer
					checkStateBloomResult("RF/Fusery/FinishReveal")
				end
			end

			if not (tempValueBloom.Accepted) then
				checkStateBloomResult = ((type(wisp) == "table") and tonumber(wisp.RequiredSpeedPower)) or 50000000000
				if (tonumber(doStepBloomResult.SpeedPower) or 0) < checkStateBloomResult then
					return getSetResult("Needs " .. (clampValue3(checkStateBloomResult) .. " speed power to meet the wisp"))
				end
				local findWorldPart = ctx.findWorldPart
				local Build = findWorldPart("Build")

				if Build then
					if not (Build:GetAttribute("EnchantedForestZoneRevealed")) then
						return getSetResult("Waiting for the Enchanted Forest to open")
					end
				else
					return getSetResult("Waiting for the Enchanted Forest to open")
				end

				findWorldPart = ctx.state
				findWorldPart.wispGo = {isPartBloom("EnchantedForestZone", "WispSpawn"), "Accept"}
				return getSetResult("Going to accept the quest")
			end

			doStepBloomResult = checkStateBloom(tempValueBloom)

			if doStepBloomResult then
				if not (isClaimed(tempValueBloom, doStepBloomResult)) then
					if toNumberOrDefault3(tempValueBloom,
						doStepBloomResult) >= (tonumber(doStepBloomResult.Target) or 1) then
						checkStateBloomResult = ctx.invokeServer
						checkStateBloomResult("RF/WispCompanion/Request", "Claim", doStepBloomResult.Id)
						return getSetResult("Claimed " .. tostring(doStepBloomResult.Title))
					end
				end
			end

			if (tonumber(tempValueBloom.Stage) or 1) >= tempValue2 then
				if not (tempValueBloom.Returning) then
					checkStateBloomResult = ctx.invokeServer
					checkStateBloomResult("RF/WispCompanion/Request", "BeginReturn")
				end

				local state3 = ctx.state
				state3.wispGo = {isPartBloom("EnchantedForestZone", "Zone13Props", "EnchantedTree",
					"WispAnchor") or isPartBloom("EnchantedForestZone", "WispAnchor"), "Return"}
				return getSetResult("Returning the wisp")
			end

			if not doStepBloomResult then
				return getSetResult("Reading quest")
			end

			if doStepBloomResult.Event == "PetFused" then
				return scanItemsBloom(doStepBloomResult)
			end
			getSetResult(tostring(doStepBloomResult.Title) .. ((((type(doStepBloomResult.Match) == "table")
				and doStepBloomResult.Match.Rarity) and " - waiting for that egg in this server") or ""))
		end

		local doStep9Result2 = doStep9({name = "WispGo", mover = true, gap = 3, pri = 4})

		doStep9Result2.on = function()
			local hubSettings = ctx.hubSettings
			return hubSettings.wisp
		end

		doStep9Result2.want = function()
			local wispGo = ctx.state
			local wispGo2, wispGo3 = wispGo.wispGo

			if wispGo2 then
				wispGo = ctx.state
				wispGo3 = wispGo.wispGo[1]
			else
				wispGo3 = wispGo2
			end

			wispGo = nil

			if wispGo3 then
				wispGo2 = ctx.state
				wispGo = wispGo2.wispGo
			else
				wispGo = wispGo3
			end

			return wispGo or nil
		end

		doStep9Result2.run = function(input, inputBloom)
			local lookupValue = input[1]

			if ctx.waitRootAnchored(inputBloom) then
				local leaveFuse = ctx.leaveFuse
				if not (leaveFuse(inputBloom)) then
					return
				end
			else
				return
			end

			local getRootPart = ctx.getRootPart
			local fieldValueBloomResult = getRootPart()

			if fieldValueBloomResult then
				getRootPart = ctx.isBeforeAreas

				if getRootPart(fieldValueBloomResult.Position) then
					local retryUntil = ctx.retryUntil
					if not (retryUntil(inputBloom, "Wisp", 0.3)) then
						return
					end
				end
			end

			getRootPart, fieldValueBloomResult = ctx.localPlayer, ctx.localPlayer
			pcall(ctx.localPlayer.RequestStreamAroundAsync, ctx.localPlayer, lookupValue)
			local getRootPartBloom = ctx.getRootPart
			local fieldValue2Result = getRootPartBloom()
			if not (fieldValue2Result) then
				return
			end

			if (fieldValue2Result.Position - lookupValue).Magnitude > 1200 then
				if hasTimedOut() > 0 then
					getRootPartBloom = ctx.vector3New
					ragTo(lookupValue + getRootPartBloom(0, 3, 3), inputBloom)
				end
			end

			getRootPartBloom = ctx.getRootPart
			fieldValue2Result = getRootPartBloom()

			if fieldValue2Result then
				if (fieldValue2Result.Position - lookupValue).Magnitude > 40 then
					local state3, vector3NewBloom = ctx.state, ctx.vector3New
					if not (state3.stepTo(lookupValue + vector3NewBloom(0, 0, 3), inputBloom)) then
						return
					end
				end
			end

			getRootPartBloom = ctx.getHumanoid
			local fieldValue2ResultBloom, bestValue = getRootPartBloom(), 0

			while true do
				local isRecent, tempValueBloom = (fieldValue2ResultBloom and inputBloom()) and (bestValue < 3)

				if isRecent then
					getRootPartBloom = ctx.getRootPart
					tempValueBloom = (getRootPartBloom())
				else
					tempValueBloom = isRecent
				end

				isRecent = nil

				if tempValueBloom then
					local getRootPart2 = ctx.getRootPart
					isRecent = (getRootPart2().Position - lookupValue).Magnitude > 6
				else
					isRecent = tempValueBloom
				end

				if not isRecent then
					break
				end
				fieldValue2ResultBloom:MoveTo(lookupValue)
				bestValue += task.wait(0.2)
			end

			task.wait(0.5)
			lookupValue = ctx.invokeServer
			lookupValue("RF/WispCompanion/Request", input[2])
			lookupValue = ctx.state
			lookupValue.wispGo = nil
		end
	end)

	-- ==== 33_hollow#1 part 1/2 ====
	runStep("33_hollow#1", function()
		local valueMap2, state = {drop = 0, n = 0}, ctx.state
		state.HL = valueMap2
		local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

		local function findFirstChild()
			return workspace:FindFirstChild("TheHollowTrack")
		end

		local function inRace()
			local localPlayerHollow = ctx.localPlayer
			return localPlayerHollow:GetAttribute("RaceId") == "TheHollowTrack"
		end

		local function readAttributeHollow()
			local firstChild, localPlayerHollow = findFirstChild(), ctx.localPlayer
			local attribute = localPlayerHollow:GetAttribute("RaceHeat")
			return ((firstChild and attribute) and firstChild:FindFirstChild("RaceHeats"))
				and firstChild.RaceHeats:FindFirstChild(attribute)
		end

		local function phase()
			local attributeHollow = readAttributeHollow()
			return attributeHollow and (attributeHollow:GetAttribute("RacePhase"))
		end

		local function readAttribute2()
			local localPlayerHollow = ctx.localPlayer
			return localPlayerHollow:GetAttribute("RaceFinishPlace") ~= nil
		end

		local function toNumberOrDefault3()
			local peekSave = ctx.peekSave
			local fieldValueResult = peekSave()
			return ((fieldValueResult and (type(fieldValueResult.TheHollow) == "table")) and tonumber(fieldValueResult.TheHollow.Wins)) or 0
		end

		local function toNumberOrDefault4()
			local max, hubSettings, tempValueHollow = math.max, ctx.hubSettings, (tonumber(ctx.hubSettings.hlSpeed)
				or 300) - valueMap2.drop
			return max(tempValueHollow, 140)
		end

		valueMap2.inRace = inRace
		valueMap2.wins = toNumberOrDefault3
		valueMap2.phase = phase
		local doStep9ResultHollow = doStep9({name = "Hollow", mover = true, gap = 1, pri = 3})
		valueMap2.job = doStep9ResultHollow

		doStep9ResultHollow.on = function()
			local hubSettings = ctx.hubSettings
			return (hubSettings.hollow == true) and (inRace() or (toNumberOrDefault3() < 3))
		end

		doStep9ResultHollow.want = function()
			return (inRace() and "race") or "enter"
		end

		local function hasTimedOutHollow()
			fireServer2("RE/MountRace/AskLeave")
			local timestamp = os.clock() + 8

			while inRace() and (os.clock() < timestamp) do
				task.wait(0.2)
			end
		end

		local function tryCallHollow(callback)
			local firstChild = findFirstChild()

			local callResult, result = pcall(function()
				return require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.RaceTrackPath).new(firstChild.AttachmentTrack)
			end)

			local getRootPart = ctx.getRootPart
			local attributeResult = getRootPart()

			if callResult then
				if result then
					if not (attributeResult) then
						return false
					end
				else
					return false
				end
			else
				return false
			end

			callResult = result.Length / 2
			local tempValueHollow = result:Project(attributeResult.Position, callResult, callResult, callResult)
			callResult = result:FrameAt(tempValueHollow)
			local computed, networkingHollow = math.max((attributeResult.Position - callResult.Position):Dot(callResult.UpVector),
				2), ctx.networking
			local reMountRacePowerUp, startTime, startTimeHollow, now2 = networkingHollow:FindFirstChild("RE/MountRace/PowerUp"), 0, 0
			attributeResult = {}

			local function hasTimedOut2()
				local cframe, getRootPartHollow = result:FrameAt(tempValueHollow), ctx.getRootPart
				local fieldValueResult = getRootPartHollow()
				if not (fieldValueResult) then
					return
				end

				if os.clock() >= startTimeHollow then
					startTimeHollow = os.clock() + 1

					if (fieldValueResult.Position - (cframe.Position + (cframe.UpVector * computed))).Magnitude > 40 then
						tempValueHollow = result:Project(fieldValueResult.Position, tempValueHollow, 300, 300)
						cframe = result:FrameAt(tempValueHollow)

						if now2 then
							if (os.clock() - now2) < 6 then
								if toNumberOrDefault4() > 140 then
									valueMap2.drop = valueMap2.drop + 20
									getRootPartHollow = ctx.setStatus
									getRootPartHollow("Pulled back, racing at " .. toNumberOrDefault4(), "warn")
								end
							end
						end

						now2 = os.clock()
					else
					end
				else
				end

				fieldValueResult.CFrame = cframe + (cframe.UpVector * computed)
				fieldValueResult.AssemblyLinearVelocity = cframe.LookVector * toNumberOrDefault4()
				getRootPartHollow = ctx.vector
				fieldValueResult.AssemblyAngularVelocity = getRootPartHollow
			end

			local function fireRemote()
				local serverTime, getRootPartHollow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), ctx.getRootPart
				local attribute2Result = getRootPartHollow()

				if reMountRacePowerUp then
					if not (attribute2Result) then
						return
					end
				else
					return
				end

				getRootPartHollow = ctx.localPlayer
				local attribute3 = getRootPartHollow:GetAttribute("RacePowerUp")

				if type(attribute3) == "string" then
					if attribute3 ~= "" then
						local localPlayerHollow, number = ctx.localPlayer, tonumber(ctx.localPlayer:GetAttribute("RacePowerUpRollEndsAt")) or 0

						if number <= serverTime then
							local localPlayer2, numberHollow = ctx.localPlayer, tonumber(ctx.localPlayer:GetAttribute("RacePowerUpEffectEndsAt")) or 0

							if numberHollow <= serverTime then
								local localPlayer3, number2 = ctx.localPlayer, tonumber(ctx.localPlayer:GetAttribute("RacePowerUpStunEndsAt")) or 0

								if number2 <= serverTime then
									reMountRacePowerUp:FireServer("Use", attribute2Result.Position,
										result:FrameAt(tempValueHollow).LookVector)
								end
							end
						end

						return
					end
				end

				for _, item in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("RacePowerUpSpawn")) do
					if item:IsDescendantOf(firstChild) then
						attribute3, getRootPartHollow = (item:FindFirstChild("Pad") or item.PrimaryPart)
							or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"), item:GetAttribute("RaceBoxReadyAt")

						if attribute3 and ((type(getRootPartHollow) ~= "number") or (getRootPartHollow <= serverTime)) then
							if (attribute3.Position - attribute2Result.Position).Magnitude <= 30 then
								reMountRacePowerUp:FireServer("Pickup", item)
								break
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			attributeResult[1] = heartbeat:Connect(function(input)
				if inRace() then
					if readAttribute2() then
						return
					end
				else
					return
				end

				local tempValueHollowRef = tempValueHollow
				tempValueHollow = tempValueHollowRef + (toNumberOrDefault4() * input)
				pcall(hasTimedOut2)
				tempValueHollowRef = ctx.hubSettings

				if tempValueHollowRef.hlPower ~= false then
					if os.clock() >= startTime then
						startTime = os.clock() + 0.2
						pcall(fireRemote)
					end
				end
			end)

			callResult = ctx.RunService

			attributeResult[2] = callResult.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
				if inRace() then
					if not (readAttribute2()) then
						pcall(hasTimedOut2)
					end
				end
			end)

			networkingHollow = ctx.localPlayer
			getRootPart, callResult = (networkingHollow:GetAttribute("RaceLap")), os.clock()

			while (callback() and (inRace())) and not readAttribute2() do
				networkingHollow = ctx.localPlayer
				local attribute2 = networkingHollow:GetAttribute("RaceLap")

				if attribute2 ~= getRootPart then
					getRootPart, callResult = attribute2, os.clock()
				else
					if (os.clock() - callResult) > (((result.Length / toNumberOrDefault4()) * 1.4) + 6) then
						callResult = os.clock()

						if toNumberOrDefault4() > 140 then
							valueMap2.drop = valueMap2.drop + 20
						end

						local getRootPartHollow = ctx.getRootPart
						local fieldValueResult = getRootPartHollow()

						if fieldValueResult then
							tempValueHollow = result:Project(fieldValueResult.Position, tempValueHollow, 600, 600)
						else
						end

						fieldValueResult = ctx.setStatus
						fieldValueResult("Lap did not count, racing at " .. toNumberOrDefault4(), "warn")
					else
					end
				end

				attribute2 = nil
				attribute2, valueMap2.say = ctx.localPlayer, ("Racing lap %s, %d studs/s"):format(tostring(ctx.localPlayer:GetAttribute("RaceLap") or 1),
					toNumberOrDefault4())
				attribute2 = ctx.setStatus
				attribute2(valueMap2.say)
				task.wait(0.25)
			end

			for _, item in ipairs(attributeResult) do
				item:Disconnect()
			end

			return readAttribute2()
		end

		doStep9ResultHollow.run = function(input, callback)
			input = os.clock()

			if not (inRace()) then
				local setStatus = ctx.setStatus
				setStatus("Joining The Hollow race")
				setStatus = ctx.invokeServer
				local AskEnter, tempValueHollow, deadline = setStatus("RF/TheHollow/AskEnter")

				if if AskEnter then tempValueHollow == false else not AskEnter then
					setStatus = ctx.setStatus
					setStatus("The Hollow: " .. tostring(deadline or "could not join"), "warn")
					doStep9ResultHollow.at = os.clock() + 15
					return
				end

				deadline = os.clock() + 6

				while true do
					tempValueHollow = inRace()
					if not (if tempValueHollow then not tempValueHollow else os.clock() < deadline) then
						break
					end
					task.wait(0.1)
				end

				if not (inRace()) then
					doStep9ResultHollow.at = os.clock() + 10
					return
				end
			end

			while ((callback() and (inRace())) and (phase() ~= "Racing")) and not readAttribute2() do
				if phase() == "Joining" then
					local stateHollow = ctx.state

					if stateHollow.better(doStep9ResultHollow) then
						local setStatus = ctx.setStatus
						setStatus("A higher task goes first, leaving The Hollow")
						return hasTimedOutHollow()
					end
				end

				local attributeHollow = readAttributeHollow()
				local tempValueHollow = attributeHollow
					and (tonumber(attributeHollow:GetAttribute("RaceGoAt")) or tonumber(attributeHollow:GetAttribute("RaceJoinEndsAt")))
				valueMap2.say = "Waiting at the start" .. ((tempValueHollow and (", go in %ds"):format(math.max(math.ceil(tempValueHollow - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()),
					0))) or "")
				attributeHollow = ctx.setStatus
				attributeHollow(valueMap2.say)
				task.wait(0.25)
			end

			if callback() then
				if not (inRace()) then
					return
				end
			else
				return
			end

			local attribute2 = readAttribute2()
			local conditionalValue = if attribute2 then not attribute2 else tryCallHollow(callback)

			if readAttribute2() then
				attribute2 = ctx.localPlayer
				local attribute, localPlayerHollow, time = attribute2:GetAttribute("RaceFinishPlace"), ctx.localPlayer, tonumber(ctx.localPlayer:GetAttribute("RaceFinishTime"))
				valueMap2.n = valueMap2.n + 1
				task.wait(1.5)
				hasTimedOutHollow()
				valueMap2.time, valueMap2.cycle = time, os.clock() - input
				valueMap2.last = ("Finished #%s in %s, round trip %ds"):format(tostring(attribute),
					(time and ("%.1fs"):format(time)) or "?", math.floor(valueMap2.cycle))
				callback = ctx.setStatus
				callback("The Hollow: " .. (valueMap2.last .. (", wins " .. toNumberOrDefault3())), "ok")
				return true
			end

			return conditionalValue
		end
	end)

	-- ==== 34_star#1 ====
	runStep("34_star#1", function()
		local state, shootingStar = {pay = nil, caught = 0, slipped = 0, askAt = 0, jumped = {}}, ctx.state
		shootingStar.SS = state
		local doStep9ResultStar = doStep9({name = "Star", mover = true, gap = 0.5, pri = 2})
		shootingStar = cacheCore["Shooting Star"]
		local tempValueStar = shootingStar:Text("Shooting Star Status", "Off")

		local entries = {Set = function(_, input, inputStar)
			if input == "Status" then
				tempValueStar:Set(inputStar)
			end
		end}

		doStepCore(shootingStar, "Auto Catch Shooting Star", "star", false, function(input)
			if not (input) then
				doStep10(doStep9ResultStar)
			end
		end)

		local function checkStateStar(pay)
			if type(pay) == "table" then
				if pay.Id ~= nil then
					if state.pay then
						if not (state.pay.Id == pay.Id) then
							state.slipped = 0
						end
					else
						state.slipped = 0
					end

					state.pay = pay
				end
			end
		end

		local function hasTimedOutStar()
			state.askAt = os.clock() + 15

			task.spawn(function()
				local invokeServer = ctx.invokeServer
				local AskState, tempValue2 = invokeServer("RF/ShootingStar/AskState")

				if AskState then
					checkStateStar(tempValue2)
				end
			end)
		end

		local function checkState2(childName, callback)
			local networkingStar = ctx.networking
			local tempValue2 = networkingStar:FindFirstChild(childName)

			if tempValue2 then
				if tempValue2:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
					trackConnection(tempValue2.OnClientEvent, callback)
				end
			end
		end

		checkState2("RE/ShootingStar/Fall", checkStateStar)

		checkState2("RE/ShootingStar/Wander", function(input, leg)
			if state.pay then
				if state.pay.Id == input then
					if type(leg) == "table" then
						state.pay.Leg = leg
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		checkState2("RE/ShootingStar/Slipped", function(input)
			if state.pay then
				if state.pay.Id == input then
					state.slipped = state.slipped + 1
					state.hold = nil
				end
			end
		end)

		checkState2("RE/ShootingStar/Claimed", function(input)
			if state.pay then
				if state.pay.Id == input then
					state.caught = state.caught + 1
					state.pay = nil
					doStep10(doStep9ResultStar)
					doStep6("Shooting Star", "Caught a star", "ok")
				end
			end
		end)

		checkState2("RE/ShootingStar/Expired", function(input)
			if state.pay then
				if state.pay.Id == input then
					state.pay = nil
					doStep10(doStep9ResultStar)
				end
			end
		end)

		hasTimedOutStar()

		local function doStepStar(data)
			local shootingStarClient = workspace:FindFirstChild("ShootingStarClient")
			local buddy = shootingStarClient and (shootingStarClient:FindFirstChild("Buddy"))
			shootingStarClient = buddy and (buddy:FindFirstChild("RootPart"))

			if shootingStarClient then
				if shootingStarClient:IsA("BasePart") then
					return shootingStarClient.Position
				end
			end

			buddy, shootingStarClient = getServerTimeNow(), data.Leg

			if type(shootingStarClient) == "table" then
				if typeof(shootingStarClient.From) == "Vector3" then
					if typeof(shootingStarClient.To) == "Vector3" then

			local vector3New11, vector3New12, hit = ctx.vector3New, ctx.vector3New, workspace:Raycast(amount + ctx.vector3New(0,
				20, 0), ctx.vector3New(0, -80, 0), raycastParams)
			localPlayerBanjo = nil

			if hit then
				raycastParams = nil
				raycastParams, localPlayerBanjo = ctx.vector3New, hit.Position + ctx.vector3New(0, 3, 0)
			else
				localPlayerBanjo = hit
			end

			return localPlayerBanjo or amount
		end

		local function checkStateBanjo(input)
			local getRootPart = ctx.getRootPart
			local fieldValueResult = getRootPart()

			if fieldValueResult then
				getRootPart = ctx.teleportRoot
				getRootPart(CFrame.lookAt(fieldValueResult.Position, ctx.vector3New(input.X, fieldValueResult.Position.Y,
					input.Z)))
			end
		end

		local function doStep13(input, inputBanjo)
			local attributeBanjo, unit = readAttributeBanjo(input), ctx.vector3New
			local unit2 = unit(attributeBanjo.X - vector3NewBanjoResult.X, 0,
				attributeBanjo.Z - vector3NewBanjoResult.Z)
			unit = (unit2.Magnitude > 0.1) and unit2.Unit

			if unit then
				unit2 = unit
			else
				local vector3New11 = ctx.vector3New
				unit2 = (vector3New11(0, 0, 1))
			end

			unit = ctx.holdOnTreadmill
			if not (unit(raycastGround(attributeBanjo + (unit2 * 6.5)), inputBanjo, 60)) then
				return false
			end
			checkStateBanjo(attributeBanjo)
			inputBanjo = ctx.state
			unit, attributeBanjo = inputBanjo.bat(), ctx.getHumanoid
			inputBanjo = attributeBanjo()

			if unit then
				if not inputBanjo then
					return false
				end
			else
				return false
			end

			attributeBanjo = ctx.localPlayer

			if unit.Parent ~= attributeBanjo.Character then
				pcall(inputBanjo.EquipTool, inputBanjo, unit)
				task.wait(0.25)
			end

			fireServer2("RE/BanjoCricket/Aim", input)
			attributeBanjo = os.clock() + 2

			while ((os.clock() < attributeBanjo) and (unit:GetAttribute("CooldownActive") == true))
				and (getServerTimeNow() < (tonumber(unit:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0)) do
				task.wait(0.05)
			end

			pcall(unit.Activate, unit)
			return true
		end

		local function hasTimedOutBanjo(input, inputBanjo, input2)
			local timestamp = os.clock() + input2

			while os.clock() < timestamp do
				if items.wrong > inputBanjo then
					return "wrong"
				end

				for _, ack in ipairs(items.acks) do
					if ack[1] == input then
						if ack[2] > inputBanjo then
							return "ok"
						end
					end
				end

				task.wait(0.05)
			end
		end

		local function readAttribute2(callback)
			local timestamp = os.clock() + 300
			items.notes = nil
			local startTime, count = 0, 0

			while callback() and (os.clock() < timestamp) do
				local notes = ctx.localPlayer

				if notes:GetAttribute("InEnchantedTree") then
					if not (doStep12()) then
						return false
					end
				else
					return false
				end

				if items.solved then
					return true
				elseif doStepBanjo().Solved == true then
					return true
				end

				notes = items.notes

				if notes then
					if os.clock() < items.listen then
						task.wait(0.05)
					else
						count = 0
						items.notes = nil
						local setStatus = ctx.setStatus
						setStatus(("Playing back %d notes"):format(#notes))
						setStatus = ipairs

						for index, note in setStatus(notes) do
							index = nil

							for indexBanjo = 1, 2, 1 do
								indexBanjo = os.clock()
								if not (doStep13(note, callback)) then
									break
								end
								index = hasTimedOutBanjo(note, indexBanjo, 1.6)
								if index then
									break
								end
							end

							if index ~= "ok" then
								note = ctx.setStatus
								note("Missed a note, starting over", "warn")
								break
							end
						end

						startTime = os.clock()
					end
				else
					if (os.clock() - startTime) > 4 then
						count += 1

						if count > 12 then
							local setStatus = ctx.setStatus
							setStatus("The mushrooms do not answer", "warn")
							return false
						end

						local setStatusBanjo = ctx.setStatus
						setStatusBanjo("Waking the mushrooms")
						doStep13(4, callback)
						startTime = os.clock()
					else
					end

					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function isPart2(callback)
			if doStep12() then
				return true
			end

			for index = 1, 2, 1 do
				index = ctx.findWorldPart
				local Build = index("Build", "EnchantedTreeInterior", "SecretLeapHint", "Streaks")
				local position, getRootPart = ((Build and Build:IsA("BasePart")) and Build.Position)
					or vector3New8Result, ctx.getRootPart
				index = getRootPart()
				if not index then
					return false
				end
				Build = ctx.setStatus
				Build("Flying to the Secret Leap")
				Build, getRootPart = ctx.holdOnTreadmill, ctx.vector3New

				if Build(getRootPart(index.Position.X, position.Y + 18, index.Position.Z), callback, 120) then
					local holdOnTreadmill, vector3New11 = ctx.holdOnTreadmill, ctx.vector3New
					if not (holdOnTreadmill(position + vector3New11(0, 18, 0), callback, 120)) then
						return false
					end
				else
					return false
				end

				Build = ctx.setStatus
				Build("Taking the Secret Leap")
				getRootPart = os.clock() + 8

				while ((os.clock() < getRootPart) and (callback())) and not doStep12() do
					task.wait(0.1)
				end

				if doStep12() then
					task.wait(1)
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function scanItemsBanjo(input)
			task.wait(5)

			for index = 1, 3, 1 do
				local AskClaim, getRootPart = tryCall3(), ctx.getRootPart
				index = getRootPart()

				if index and ((index.Position - AskClaim).Magnitude > 9) then
					getRootPart = ctx.setStatus
					getRootPart("Going to Jitterbug")
					local unit = ctx.vector3New
					local unit2 = unit(vector3New10Result.X - AskClaim.X, 0, vector3New10Result.Z - AskClaim.Z)
					unit = (unit2.Magnitude > 0.1) and unit2.Unit

					if unit then
						unit2 = unit
					else
						local vector3New11 = ctx.vector3New
						unit2 = (vector3New11(0, 0, -1))
					end

					local ipairsFn, entries = ipairs, {raycastGround(vector3New9Result), raycastGround(vector3New10Result),
						raycastGround(AskClaim + (unit2 * 6))}

					for _, item in ipairsFn(entries) do
						unit = ctx.holdOnTreadmill
						if not (unit(item, input, 60)) then
							return false
						end
					end

					checkStateBanjo(AskClaim)
				end

				AskClaim = ctx.setStatus
				AskClaim("Claiming Cricket's Banjo")
				index = ctx.invokeServer
				AskClaim, getRootPart = index("RF/BanjoCricket/AskClaim")

				if getRootPart == true then
					return true
				elseif doStepBanjo().Claimed == true then
					return true
				end

				task.wait(1)
			end

			return doStepBanjo().Claimed == true
		end

		local function hasTimedOut2()
			local getHumanoidBanjo = ctx.getHumanoid
			local passagesResult = getHumanoidBanjo()

			local function isValue()
				return true
			end

			if passagesResult then
				pcall(passagesResult.UnequipTools, passagesResult)
			end

			if doStep12() then
				getHumanoidBanjo, passagesResult = isPartBanjo("Passages",
					"SecretRoomExit") or vector3New7Result, ctx.holdOnTreadmill
				passagesResult(getHumanoidBanjo, isValue, 60)
				local timestamp = os.clock() + 5

				while (os.clock() < timestamp) and (doStep12()) do
					local teleportRoot, cFrameNewBanjo = ctx.teleportRoot, ctx.cFrameNew
					teleportRoot(cFrameNewBanjo(getHumanoidBanjo))
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end

			getHumanoidBanjo = ctx.state
			getHumanoidBanjo.leaveTree()
		end

		local doStep9ResultBanjo = doStep9({name = "Banjo", mover = true, gap = 3, pri = 6, soft = true})

		doStep9ResultBanjo.on = function()
			local hubSettings = ctx.hubSettings
			return hubSettings.banjo and not items.done
		end

		local function checkState2(banjoCricket)
			local state = ctx.state

			if state.wispSay then
				local stateBanjo = ctx.state
				stateBanjo.wispSay("Banjo cricket: " .. banjoCricket)
			end
		end

		doStep9ResultBanjo.want = function()
			if doStepBanjo().Claimed == true then
				items.done = true
				return checkState2("done, Cricket's Banjo is yours")
			end
			local localPlayerBanjo = ctx.localPlayer
			if localPlayerBanjo:GetAttribute("EnchantedTreeUnlocked") ~= true then
				return checkState2("needs the Enchanted Tree open (finish the wisp quest)")
			end
			localPlayerBanjo = ctx.state
			if not (localPlayerBanjo.bat()) then
				return checkState2("needs a bat in your bag")
			end

			if os.clock() < items.next then
				return
			end
			return true
		end

		doStep9ResultBanjo.run = function(input, inputBanjo)
			input = ctx.state
			if not (input.needBody()) then
				return checkState2("leaving invisibility first")
			end
			items.next = os.clock() + 15

			if ctx.waitRootAnchored(inputBanjo) then
				input = ctx.state
				if not (input.enterTree(inputBanjo)) then
					return checkState2("could not get into the Enchanted Tree")
				end
			else
				return checkState2("could not get into the Enchanted Tree")
			end

			if not (isPart2(inputBanjo)) then
				hasTimedOut2()
				return checkState2("could not take the Secret Leap")
			end

			if doStepBanjo().Solved ~= true then
				if not (items.solved) then
					if not (readAttribute2(inputBanjo)) then
						hasTimedOut2()
						return checkState2("puzzle not solved, trying again")
					end
				end
			end

			if scanItemsBanjo(inputBanjo) then
				items.done = true
				doStep6("Banjo", "Cricket's Banjo claimed", "ok")
				checkState2("done, Cricket's Banjo is yours")
			end

			hasTimedOut2()
		end
	end)

		local function clampValue(input, callback)

			while os.clock() < timestamp do
				if callback then
					if not (callback()) then
						return false
					end
				end

				task.wait(math.min(0.05, math.max(timestamp - os.clock(), 0)))
			end

		end

		local function hasTimedOut5(input)

					end

					startTime = os.clock()
					local vector3NewHalloween, hit = ctx.vector3New, workspace:Raycast(fieldValueResult.Position,
						ctx.vector3New(0, -12, 0), raycastParams)
					local tempValueHalloween, partBoundsInRadiuMap2 = (hit and hit.Position.Y)
						or (fieldValueResult.Position.Y - 3), {}

					for _, partBoundsInRadiu in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(fieldValueResult.Position, 14,
						overlapParams)) do
						if partBoundsInRadiu.CanCollide or partBoundsInRadiuMap[partBoundsInRadiu] then

								if (partBoundsInRadiu.Position.Y + (partBoundsInRadiu.Size.Y / 2)) > (tempValueHalloween + 1.5) then
									partBoundsInRadiuMap2[partBoundsInRadiu] = true
									partBoundsInRadiuMap[partBoundsInRadiu] = true
									partBoundsInRadiu.CanCollide = false
								end
							end
						end
					end

							if value.Parent then
								value.CanCollide = true
							end
						end
					end
				end

					if value.Parent then

					end
				end

				for value in next, partBoundsInRadiuMap, nil do
					if value.Parent then

					end

				table.clear(partBoundsInRadiuMap)

		state = ctx.RunService

		trackConnection(state.Stepped, function()
			if stateHalloween.move then

		local function hasTimedOut14(callback, callbackHalloween, input)

			end

					return input(inputHalloween)
				end)
			end
		end

		local function scanItems5(amount)
			local raycastParams3 = RaycastParams.new()
			raycastParams3.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local instances, localPlayerHalloween = {}, ctx.localPlayer
			instances[1] = localPlayerHalloween.Character

			for index = 1, 6, 1 do
				raycastParams3.FilterDescendantsInstances = instances
				local vector3NewHalloween, vector3New2, hit2 = ctx.vector3New, ctx.vector3New, workspace:Raycast(amount + ctx.vector3New(0,
					40, 0), ctx.vector3New(0, -180, 0), raycastParams3)
				if not (hit2) then
					return nil
				end
				index = hit2.Instance

				if hit2.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
					return hit2.Position
				elseif index:GetAttribute("TerrainRole") == "Basin" then
					return hit2.Position
				elseif index:GetAttribute("FishingWater") then
					return hit2.Position
				elseif CollectionService:HasTag(index, "FishingWater") then
					return hit2.Position
				end

				if index:IsA("BasePart") then
					if not (index.Transparency >= 0.95) then
						return nil
					end
				else
					return nil
				end

				instances[#instances + 1] = index
			end
		end

		local function parseCFrame(data, input)
			local raycastParams3, characters = RaycastParams.new(), {}

			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player.Character then
					characters[#characters + 1] = player.Character
				end
			end

			raycastParams3.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			raycastParams3.FilterDescendantsInstances = characters
			raycastParams3.RespectCanCollide = true
			local vector3NewHalloween, vector3New2, hit2, getHumanoidHalloween = ctx.vector3New, ctx.vector3New, workspace:Raycast(data.Position + ctx.vector3New(0,
				4, 0), ctx.vector3New(0, -20, 0), raycastParams3), ctx.getHumanoid
			raycastParams3 = getHumanoidHalloween()
			getHumanoidHalloween, characters = (hit2 and ((hit2.Position.Y + ((raycastParams3 and raycastParams3.HipHeight) or 2)) + (data.Size.Y / 2)))
				or data.Position.Y, ctx.vector3New
			hit2 = characters(data.Position.X, getHumanoidHalloween, data.Position.Z)

			if raycastParams3 then
				characters = ctx.vector
				raycastParams3:Move(characters)
				raycastParams3:MoveTo(hit2)
			end

			characters = ctx.vector3New
			return CFrame.lookAt(hit2, characters(input.X, getHumanoidHalloween, input.Z))
		end

		local function readAttribute6(instance, input, inputHalloween)

							0, 1)) or 0))

			return isPartHalloween(instance.Parent)
		end

		local function scanItemsPumpkin(input, inputPumpkin, amount, input2)
			if not (tryCall4(input, input2)) then
				return input, false
			end
			local ipairsFn, entries, magnitude, tempValue2 = ipairs, {amount * 0.6, amount, amount + 15}

			for index, item in ipairsFn(entries) do
				for indexPumpkin = 0, 11, 1 do
					amount, index = math.rad(indexPumpkin * 30), ctx.vector3New
					indexPumpkin = index(inputPumpkin.X + (math.cos(amount) * item), input.Y,
						inputPumpkin.Z + (math.sin(amount) * item))
					local magnitude2 = (indexPumpkin - input).Magnitude

					if if magnitude then magnitude2 < magnitude else not magnitude then
						if tryCall4(indexPumpkin, input2) then
						else
							magnitude, tempValue2 = magnitude2, indexPumpkin
						end
					else
					end
				end
			end

			return tempValue2 or input, true
		end

		local function checkState2(amount, amountPumpkin, threshold, input, data)
			local getRootPartPumpkin = ctx.getRootPart
			local fieldValue2Result, humanoid = getRootPartPumpkin(), arena()
			if not (fieldValue2Result) then
				return 1 / 0
			end
			getRootPartPumpkin = fieldValue.flat(amount - fieldValue2Result.Position)
			local isRecent, tempValue2 = (getRootPartPumpkin.Magnitude > 2)
				and (getRootPartPumpkin.Unit * math.min(input or (doStep2() * 0.95), getRootPartPumpkin.Magnitude / 0.1))

			if isRecent then
				tempValue2 = isRecent
			else
				input = ctx.vector3New
				tempValue2 = (input(0, 0, 0))
			end

			isRecent = nil

			if data then
				isRecent = data
			else
				input = ctx.vector3New
				isRecent = (input(0, 0, 0))
			end

			data, amount, input = tempValue2 + isRecent, humanoid
				and tonumber(humanoid:GetAttribute("FloorY")), fieldValue2Result.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y

			if threshold then
				if amount then
					isRecent = ctx.getHumanoid
					humanoid = isRecent()
					tempValue2 = (amount + ((humanoid and humanoid.HipHeight) or 2)) + (fieldValue2Result.Size.Y / 2)
					input = math.clamp((math.max(tempValue2 + (((getRootPartPumpkin.Magnitude > 30) and 25) or 0),
						((threshold > 0) and (tempValue2 + threshold)) or 0) - fieldValue2Result.Position.Y) * 6, -80, 80)
				else
				end
			else
			end

			if (os.clock() - (state3.skAt or 0)) > 1 then
				state3.stuck = ((state3.skP and (getRootPartPumpkin.Magnitude > 8)) and (data.Magnitude > 20))
					and ((fieldValue2Result.Position - state3.skP).Magnitude < 3)
				state3.skAt, state3.skP = os.clock(), fieldValue2Result.Position
			end

			input = if state3.stuck then 60 else input
			tempValue2 = ctx.vector3New
			fieldValue2Result.AssemblyLinearVelocity = tempValue2(data.X, input, data.Z)
			data = amountPumpkin and fieldValue.flat(amountPumpkin - fieldValue2Result.Position)

			if data then
				if data.Magnitude > 0.1 then
					amount = ctx.cFrameNew
					fieldValue2Result.CFrame = amount(fieldValue2Result.Position, fieldValue2Result.Position + data.Unit)
				end
			end

			return getRootPartPumpkin.Magnitude
		end

		local function hasTimedOut2(part, firstValue)

				lp2 = (vector3NewPumpkin(0, 0, 0))
			end

			state3.lt = now2

			now2 = (isRecent.Magnitude > 0.1) and isRecent.Unit

				isRecent = now2
			else

				isRecent = (firstValue(0, 0, 1))
			end

			firstValue, now2 = part.CFrame, part.Size / 2
			local tempValue2, arenaResult = (math.abs(isRecent:Dot(firstValue.RightVector)) * now2.X) + (math.abs(isRecent:Dot(firstValue.LookVector)) * now2.Z), arena()
			local tempValue5, scanItemsPumpkinResult, tempValue6 = (arenaResult and tonumber(arenaResult:GetAttribute("FloorY")))
				or (getRootPartPumpkin.Y - now2.Y), scanItemsPumpkin(getRootPartPumpkin - ((isRecent * tempValue2) * 0.6),
				getRootPartPumpkin, math.max(now2.X, now2.Z) + 3, true)

			if tempValue6 then
				state3.say = "Dodging the boss attack"
			end

			state3.nc = true
			checkState2(scanItemsPumpkinResult, getRootPartPumpkin,
				((fieldValue.flat(scanItemsPumpkinResult - positionResult.Position).Magnitude > 25) and (((getRootPartPumpkin.Y + now2.Y) - tempValue5) + 10))
				or math.max((getRootPartPumpkin.Y + (now2.Y / 2)) - tempValue5,
				((getRootPartPumpkin.Y - now2.Y) - tempValue5) + 12, 12), nil, ((lp2.Magnitude < 400) and lp2) or nil)
		end

					for key, drop2 in next, state3.drops, nil do
						if typeof(drop2.Position) == "Vector3" then
							if serverTimeNow >= (tonumber(drop2.CollectAfter) or 0) then
								if (drop2.Position - getRootPartPumpkin).Magnitude <= (tonumber(drop2.Radius) or 7) then
									drop2.req = os.clock()
									ks2[#ks2 + 1] = key
								end
							end
						end
					end

					fireServer2("RE/PumpkinBoss/Collect", ks2)
				end

				return
			end

			if readAttribute3() then
				getRootPartPumpkin = arenaResult:FindFirstChild("Vines")
				serverTimeNow = getRootPartPumpkin and scanTablePumpkin(getRootPartPumpkin:GetChildren(),
					attributeResult.Position)
				state3.say = "Breaking the vines"

				if serverTimeNow then
					checkState6(fieldValue.posOf(serverTimeNow), 4)
				end

				return hasTimedOutPumpkin()
			end

			if text == "Shield" then
				serverTimeNow = readAttribute4(arenaResult, attributeResult)
				local operatorZone, rootHitbox = serverTimeNow
					and (serverTimeNow:FindFirstChild("OperatorZone")), serverTimeNow
					and (serverTimeNow:FindFirstChild("RootHitbox"))

				if serverTimeNow then
					if serverTimeNow:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then
						if rootHitbox then
							if rootHitbox:IsA("BasePart") then
								state3.say = "Breaking the roots on the cannon"
								checkState6(rootHitbox.Position, (math.max(rootHitbox.Size.X, rootHitbox.Size.Z) / 2) + 3)
								return hasTimedOutPumpkin()
							end
						end
					end
				end

				state3.say = "Shield up, firing the cannon"
				rootHitbox = operatorZone and scanItemsPumpkin(operatorZone.Position, operatorZone.Position, 14, false)

				if operatorZone then
					if checkState2(rootHitbox) <= 2.5 then
						if serverTimeNow:GetAttribute("Ready") == true then
							if (os.clock() - state3.at) >= 1.05 then
								state3.at, state3.shot = os.clock(), state3.shot + 1
								fireServer2("RE/PumpkinBoss/CannonFire", state3.shot)
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return
			end

			attributeResult = readAttribute2(arenaResult)
			arenaResult = getRootPart(attributeResult)

			if arenaResult and (((text == "Brute") or (text == "King")) or (text == "Stunned")) then
				state3.say = ((text == "Stunned") and "King stunned, hitting hard")
					or ("Fighting the Pumpkin " .. (((attributeResult.Name == "King") and "King") or "Brute"))
				hasTimedOut2(arenaResult, attributeResult)
				return hasTimedOutPumpkin()
			end

			state3.say = ((text == "Defeated") and "Boss defeated, collecting drops")
				or ("Waiting for the fight (" .. (text .. ")"))
			return fieldValue.pause(0.2, input)
		end

			local function toStringValue(input)
				return (tostring(input or ""):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;"))
			end

			local function tryGet(dataHwui)
				pcall(function()
					local tempValueHwui = dataHwui.Get()

					if tempValueHwui then
						if tempValueHwui:IsA("TextLabel") then
							tempValueHwui.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
						end
					end
				end)

			local function checkState2(value)
				local assets

				if value then
					local modules = ctx.modules
					assets = modules.Assets
				else
					assets = value
				end

				local tempValueHwui

				if assets then
					local modules = ctx.modules
					tempValueHwui = modules.Assets.Directory[value]
				else
					tempValueHwui = assets
				end

				value = (tempValueHwui and (type(tempValueHwui.Rarity) == "table")) and tempValueHwui.Rarity.Color
				if typeof(value) ~= "Color3" then
					return "#FFFFFF"
				end
				local tempValue5, tempValue6, tempValue7 = value:ToHSV()
				return "#" .. (if tempValue7 < 0.7 then Color3.fromHSV(tempValue5, math.min(tempValue6, 0.6),
					((tempValue6 < 0.15) and 1) or 0.95) else value):ToHex()
			end

			local function doStepHwui(input)
				local cardWidgets = {Icon = input:Image({Parent = entries.Frame, X = 0, Y = 0, Width = factorHwui,
					Height = factorHwui, Corner = 0.35, Background = "#000000", BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, StrokeThickness = factor5, StrokeTransparency = 0, Visible = false}), Name = input:Text({Parent = entries.Frame, X = 0, Y = 0, Width = 1, Height = 1.1, Scale = 1.05, Wrap = false, Font = font, TextStrokeTransparency = 1, Visible = false}), Chip = input:Frame({Parent = entries.Frame, X = 0, Y = 0, Width = factor3, Height = factor4, Corner = 0.3, Background = "#000000", BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, StrokeThickness = factor5, StrokeTransparency = 0, Visible = false})}

					Height = factor4, Scale = 0.78, Wrap = false, Align = "Center", VAlign = "center", Font = font2, TextStrokeTransparency = 1})
				cardWidgets.Detail = input:Text({Parent = entries.Frame, X = 0, Y = 0, Width = 1, Height = 1, Scale = 0.92,
					Wrap = false, Visible = false})

			local function doStep12(dataHwui, amountHwui, amount4, amount5, firstValue)
				dataHwui.Icon.Set({Visible = firstValue, X = factor, Y = amountHwui + 0.25, Width = factorHwui,
					Height = factorHwui})

				state.Width, state.Height = math.max(1, (amount5 - factor3) - 0.3), 1.1
				set(state)
				dataHwui.Chip.Set({Visible = firstValue, X = (amount4 + amount5) - factor3, Y = amountHwui + 0.35,
					Width = factor3, Height = factor4})
				dataHwui.ChipText.Set({X = 0, Y = 0, Width = factor3, Height = factor4})
				dataHwui.Detail.Set({Visible = firstValue, X = amount4, Y = amountHwui + 1.4, Width = amount5,
					Height = 1})
			end

			local function scanTableHwui()
				if entries.S then
					if entries.U <= 0 then
						return
					end
				else
					return
				end

				local computed = math.max(4, entries.U - (factor * 2))
				local tempValueHwui = computed / 4

				for index, stat in ipairs(entries.Stats) do
					local tempValue5 = factor + ((index - 1) * tempValueHwui)
					stat.Icon.Set({X = tempValue5, Y = 0.35, Width = 1.7, Height = 1.7})
					local set, state = stat.Val.Set, {X = tempValue5 + 2, Y = 0.25}
					state.Width, state.Height = math.max(1, tempValueHwui - 2.1), 1.1
					set(state)
					state, index = stat.Lab.Set, {X = tempValue5 + 2, Y = 1.3}
					index.Width, index.Height = math.max(1, tempValueHwui - 2.1), 0.9
					state(index)
				end

				tempValueHwui = (factor + factorHwui) + 0.5
				local computedHwui, factor6 = math.max(1, (entries.U - tempValueHwui) - 0.5), 2.6
				entries.Div1.Set({X = factor, Y = 2.45, Width = computed, Height = 0.06})
				entries.BestTag.Set({Visible = entries.HasBest, X = factor, Y = 2.7, Width = computed, Height = 1})
				entries.BestBg.Set({Visible = entries.HasBest, X = factor - 0.25, Y = 3.6500000000000004,
					Width = computed + 0.5, Height = factor2 + 0.15})

				if entries.HasBest then
					doStep12(entries.Best, 3.7, tempValueHwui, computedHwui, true)
					factor6 += (1.1 + factor2) + 0.75
				else
					doStep12(entries.Best, factor6, tempValueHwui, computedHwui, false)
				end

				entries.Div2.Set({Visible = entries.HasBest and (entries.N > 0), X = factor, Y = factor6 - 0.35,
					Width = computed, Height = 0.06})
				entries.EggTag.Set({Visible = entries.N > 0, X = factor, Y = factor6 - 0.1, Width = computed, Height = 1})
				factor6 = if entries.N > 0 then factor6 + 1 else factor6

				for index, row in ipairs(entries.Rows) do
					doStep12(row, factor6 + ((index - 1) * factor2), tempValueHwui, computedHwui, index <= entries.N)
				end

				tempValueHwui = (factor6 + (math.max(entries.N, (entries.HasBest and 0) or 1) * factor2)) + 0.15
				entries.Empty.Set({Visible = (entries.N == 0) and not entries.HasBest, X = factor, Y = factor6 + 0.6,
					Width = computed, Height = 1})
				entries.Frame.Set({X = 0, Y = 0, Width = entries.U, Height = tempValueHwui})

				if math.abs(tempValueHwui - (entries.H or -1)) > 0.01 then
					entries.H = tempValueHwui
					entries.S:SetContentLines(tempValueHwui)
				end
			end

			local function scanTable3(input)
				local list3, amountHwui = {}, 0

				for _, mut in next, input.muts, nil do
					amountHwui += mut
				end

				local amount4 = 0

				for _, egg in next, input.eggs, nil do
					amount4 += egg
				end

				local strokeColor, entriesHwui = ipairs, {input.n, input.candy, amount4, amountHwui}

				for index, item in strokeColor(entriesHwui) do
					local set, state = entries.Stats[index].Val.Set, {}
					state.Text = "<font color=\"#" .. (itemsHwui[index][3] .. ("\"><b>" .. (hw2.num(item) .. "</b></font>")))
					set(state)
				end

				entriesHwui, strokeColor = ipairs, {input.eggs, input.pets}

				for _, item in entriesHwui(strokeColor) do
					for key, value in next, item, nil do
						local tempValueHwui, tempValue5, tempValue6 = hw2.icon(key)
						list3[#list3 + 1] = {n = key, k = value, img = tempValueHwui, rar = tempValue5,
							col = checkState2(tempValue6)}
					end
				end

				table.sort(list3, function(inputHwui, input2)
					return (inputHwui.k > input2.k) or ((inputHwui.k == input2.k) and (inputHwui.n < input2.n))
				end)

				local tempValue7, tempValue8, set, row, tempValue9 = hw2.best(input)
				entries.HasBest = tempValue7 ~= nil

				if tempValue7 then
					strokeColor, entriesHwui, input = checkState2(tempValue9), entries.Best.Icon.Set, {}
					input.Image, input.StrokeColor = row or "", strokeColor
					entriesHwui(input)
					local set2, state = entries.Best.Name.Set, {}
					state.Text = "<b>" .. (toStringValue(tempValue7) .. "</b>")
					set2(state)
					entries.Best.Chip.Set({StrokeColor = strokeColor})
					entries.Best.ChipText.Set({Text = toStringValue(tempValue8 or ""), Color = Color3.fromHex(strokeColor)})
					set2, state = entries.Best.Detail.Set, {}
					state.Text = (set and ("<font color=\"#3CFF5A\"><b>" .. (hw2.money(set.v) .. ("</b></font>" .. ((set.s and ("  <font color=\"" .. (hexColor .. ("\">x" .. (("%.2f"):format(set.s) .. "</font>"))))) or ""))))) or ""
					set2(state)
				end

				entries.N = math.min(#list3, amount)

				for index = 1, entries.N, 1 do
					tempValue9, row = list3[index], entries.Rows[index]
					row.Icon.Set({Image = tempValue9.img or "", StrokeColor = tempValue9.col})
					set, strokeColor = row.Name.Set, {}
					strokeColor.Text = "<b>" .. (toStringValue(tempValue9.n) .. "</b>")
					set(strokeColor)
					row.Chip.Set({StrokeColor = tempValue9.col})
					row.ChipText.Set({Text = "x" .. hw2.num(tempValue9.k), Color = Color3.fromHex(tempValue9.col)})
					entriesHwui, tempValue7 = row.Detail.Set, {}
					tempValue7.Text = "<font color=\"" .. (tempValue9.col .. ("\"><b>" .. (toStringValue(tempValue9.rar
						or "") .. "</b></font>")))
					entriesHwui(tempValue7)
				end

				entries.Want = true
			end

			entries.Canvas = data:Surface({Name = "Fishing History", Layout = "free", Style = {TextScale = 1,
				LineHeight = 1.1, MinLines = 2, MaxLines = 40, AutoHeight = true, BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,
				255, 255), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.7}, Build = function(input)
				entries.S = input

				entries.Div1 = input:Frame({Parent = entries.Frame, X = 0, Y = 0, Width = 1, Height = 0.06,

					Background = "#FFFFFF", BackgroundTransparency = 0.85, Visible = false})

				for index = 1, amount, 1 do

				end

				entries.Empty = input:Text({Parent = entries.Frame, X = 0, Y = 0, Width = 1, Height = 1, Scale = 0.92,
					Wrap = false, Align = "Center", Text = "<font color=\"" .. (hexColor .. "\">No eggs caught yet</font>"), Visible = false})

				input:OnResize(function(_, amountHwui, inputHwui)
					if amountHwui ~= entries.W then
						entries.W, entries.U = amountHwui, amountHwui / math.max(inputHwui, 1)
						entries.Want = true
					end
				end)

				entries.Dirty = entries.L ~= nil
			end})

			data = ctx.RunService

			trackConnection(data.Heartbeat, function()
				if entries.Dirty then
					if entries.S then
						if entries.L then
							entries.Dirty = false
							pcall(scanTable3, entries.L)
						end
					end
				end

				if entries.Want then
					if entries.S then
						entries.Want = false
						pcall(scanTableHwui)
					end
				end
			end)

			return function(input)
				entries.L = input
				entries.Dirty = true
			end
		end

		local function getHumanoidCombat(player, input)
			local character = ctx.localPlayer

				return
			end

			character = player.Character

		end

		local function readAttributeCombat(input)

			else

		local function readAttribute2(input, data)
			if workspace:GetAttribute("PvPDisabled") then
				return
			end
			local state = ctx.state
			local tempValueCombat, stateCombat = state.bat()
			state = ctx.getRootPart
			local stateResult, attributeCombat = state(), readAttributeCombat(stateCombat)

			if tempValueCombat then

			end

				return
			end
			stateCombat = ctx.state

			end

					return
				end
			end

			end

			count += 1
			data = ctx.localPlayer
			fireServer2("RE/BatSwing/Trigger", input, ("%d:%d:%d"):format(data.UserId, count,

			pcall(tempValueCombat.Activate, tempValueCombat)
		end

			end

			while callback() do

					now2, input = os.clock(), checkState2()
					if not (input) then
						break
					end
				else
				end

				if not (state.chase(input)) then
					break
				end
				state = ctx.waitHeartbeat
				state()
			end

			end

			local function scanTable9()
				if not (ScreenGui) then

				end

					Center = 0}, 0

				end

				valueMap2.Left = left
				valueMap2.Right = left
				valueMap2.Center = left

				for index, Frame in ipairs(Frames) do
					if Frame.Id ~= "Signature" then
						local uDim, column = parseUDim2(Frame.Id, numVal, isValueResult, doStep19Result.Y), Frame.Column
						index = valueMap2[column] or left

						if uDim then
							Frame.Frame.Position = uDim
						elseif column == "Left" then
							Frame.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -computed, 0, index)
						elseif column == "Right" then
							Frame.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, computed, 0, index)
						else
							Frame.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, index)
						end

						end
					end
				end
			end

					local isRecent = countRef <= #items
					if not (isRecent and ((os.clock() - now2) < 0.001)) then
						break
					end
					isRecent = items[count]
					count += 1

					if type(isRecent) == "function" then
						isRecent()
					elseif isRecent.Parent and not (isRecent:IsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(isRecent)) then

					end
				end

				end
			end)

		local function scanItemsSystem(items, input)
			local inputRef = input

			for index = 1, #items, 1 do
				inputRef = bxor(inputRef, string.byte(items, index))
				inputRef = (((inputRef % 256) * 16777216) + (inputRef * 403)) % amountSystem
			end

			return inputRef
		end

		local function scanItems3(items)
			local textSystem = Random.new()
			local text2 = string.format("%08x%08x", textSystem:NextInteger(0, 4294967295), textSystem:NextInteger(0,
				4294967295))
			local scanItemsSystemResult, scanItemsSystemResultSystem, _ = scanItemsSystem(text.Secret .. text2,
				2166136261), scanItemsSystem(text2 .. text.Secret, 2654435769), table.create(#items)

			for index = 1, #items, 1 do
				scanItemsSystemResult = bxor(scanItemsSystemResult, lshift(scanItemsSystemResult, 13))
				scanItemsSystemResult = bxor(scanItemsSystemResult, rshift(scanItemsSystemResult, 17))
				scanItemsSystemResult, scanItemsSystemResultSystem = bxor(scanItemsSystemResult,
					lshift(scanItemsSystemResult, 5)), bxor(scanItemsSystemResultSystem, lshift(scanItemsSystemResultSystem, 13))
				scanItemsSystemResultSystem = bxor(scanItemsSystemResultSystem, rshift(scanItemsSystemResultSystem, 17))
				scanItemsSystemResultSystem = bxor(scanItemsSystemResultSystem, lshift(scanItemsSystemResultSystem, 5))
				_[index] = string.format("%02x", bxor(string.byte(items, index), band(bxor(rshift(scanItemsSystemResult,
					8), rshift(scanItemsSystemResultSystem, 16)), 255)))
			end

			items = table.concat(_)
			return "c3." .. (text2 .. ("." .. (items .. ("." .. string.format("%08x%08x",

		local function checkStateSystem(amount4)
			if amount4 >= 1000000000000 then
				return string.format("%.2fT/s", amount4 / 1000000000000)
			end

			if amount4 >= 1000000000 then
				return string.format("%.2fB/s", amount4 / 1000000000)
			end

			if amount4 >= 1000000 then
				return string.format("%.2fM/s", amount4 / 1000000)
			end
			return string.format("%d/s", math.floor(amount4))
		end

			end

			return cache[keyName] or nil
		end

		local function readAttributeSystem(instance, items)

					end

		end

		local function checkState15(amount)
			local parts2, label = state3.Parts, state3.Label

			if parts2 then
				if label then
					if not (label.Parent) then
						return
					end

					return
				end
			else
				return
			end

			local rng = state3.Rng

			if not (state3.Burst) then
				if amount < state3.NextBurst then
					return
				end

				if label.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 then
					state3.NextBurst = amount + 1
					return
				end
				local uiStroke, uiGradient = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"), label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
				state3.Burst = {Start = amount, NextTick = 0, Elapsed = 0, Duration = rng:NextNumber(valueMap2.DurMin,
					valueMap2.DurMax), Split = rng:NextNumber(valueMap2.TearMin, valueMap2.TearMax), Orig = {Text = label.Text, Position = label.Position, Rotation = label.Rotation, TextTransparency = label.TextTransparency, Stroke = (uiStroke and uiStroke.Color)
					or nil, Offset = (uiGradient and uiGradient.Offset) or nil}}
				return
			end

			local burst = state3.Burst
			if amount < burst.NextTick then
				return
			end
			burst.NextTick = amount + valueMap2.Tick
			burst.Elapsed = amount - burst.Start

				state3.Burst = nil
				state3.NextBurst = amount + rng:NextNumber(valueMap2.BurstMin, valueMap2.BurstMax)
				return
			end

			clampValue5(burst, label, parts2)
		end

		local function order()
			table.sort(iMap, function(input, inputRun)
				local mover, mover2 = (input.mover and doStepRun(input)) or 99, (inputRun.mover and doStepRun(inputRun)) or 99
				if mover ~= mover2 then
					return mover < mover2

				return input.i < inputRun.i
			end)
		end

		enabledFlags = ctx.state
		enabledFlags.order = order
		order()

			end

		end

			else
				state = nil

			end

		end
