		local function tryCall4()
			local schedTok, state = {}, ctx.state
			state.schedTok = schedTok

			while true do
				local fieldValue, schedErr = ctx.flag

				if fieldValue then
					state = ctx.state
					schedErr = state.schedTok == schedTok
				else
					schedErr = fieldValue
				end

				if not schedErr then
					break
				end

				fieldValue, schedErr = xpcall(function()
					local now2, list3, list4, ipairsFn = os.clock(), {}, {}, ipairs

					for index, item in ipairsFn(iMap) do
						if item.mover then
							if item ~= ctx.lastMV then
								if item.on then
									if tryCallRun(item) then
										index = tryCall3(item)
										item.inq = (index and true) or nil

										if index then
											item.rank = ((type(index) == "number") and index) or nil
											list3[#list3 + 1], list4[#list4 + 1] = item, item
										elseif not (item.ready) then
											if now2 >= item.at then
												item.rank = nil
												list4[#list4 + 1] = item
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end

					table.sort(list3, checkState6)
					table.sort(list4, checkState6)
					local stateRun, state3 = ctx.state, ctx.state
					stateRun.queue = list3
					state3.queueAt = now2
					stateRun = hasTimedOutRun()

					if if stateRun then not stateRun else doStep() then
						state3 = ipairs

						for index, item in state3(list4) do
							list3, ipairsFn = ctx.lastMV, checkStateRun(item)
							local isNegated, tempValueRun = not ipairsFn

							if ipairsFn then
								tempValueRun = isNegated
							else
								local isNegatedRun, dawnNow = not list3

								if list3 then
									local soft, soft2 = list3.soft or list3.idle

									if soft then
										soft2 = soft
									else
										local preempt, preempt2 = item.preempt

										if preempt then
											preempt2 = preempt
										else
											local tempValue2, dawnNow2 = item.name == "Steal"

											if tempValue2 then
												index = ctx.state
												dawnNow2 = index.dawnNow
											else
												dawnNow2 = tempValue2
											end

											if dawnNow2 then
												tempValue2 = ctx.state
												preempt2 = tempValue2.dawnNow()
											else
												preempt2 = dawnNow2
											end
										end

										if preempt2 then
											local hold, hold2 = list3.hold

											if hold then
												preempt = ctx.isSelectedUid
												local preemptResult = preempt()

												if preemptResult then
													hold2 = preemptResult
												else
													local state4 = ctx.state
													hold2 = state4.hwCarrying()
												end
											else
												hold2 = hold
											end

											soft2 = not hold2
										else
											soft2 = preempt2
										end
									end

									dawnNow = soft2 and (getRank(item) < list3.erank)
								else
									dawnNow = isNegatedRun
								end

								tempValueRun = dawnNow or (item.urgent and not list3.hold)
							end

							if tempValueRun then
								if not (item.aux) then
									isNegated = ctx.state

									if isNegated.stealDawn then
										index = ctx.state
										if index.stealDawn(getRank(item)) then
											break
										end
									end
								end

								if now2 < item.at then
									if item.inq then
										break
									end
									continue
								elseif item.busy then
									if item.inq then
										break
									end
									continue
								end

								item.at = now2 + item.gap
								local ok2, result = pcall(item.want)

								if ok2 then
									if result == "wait" then
										break
									end
								end

								item.lastWant = (ok2 and (result ~= nil)) and (result ~= false)

								if item.lastWant then
									if ctx.lastMV == list3 then
										hasTimedOut2(item, result)
										break
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end

					ipairsFn = ipairs

					for _, item in ipairsFn(iMap) do
						stateRun, list4 = ctx.flag and not item.mover

						if stateRun then
							list3 = item.busy

						end

											pcall(item.fn)

										end)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end, debug.traceback)

				if not fieldValue then
					local stateRun = ctx.state
					stateRun.schedErr = schedErr
					stateRun = ctx.setStatus
					stateRun("Scheduler: " .. tostring(schedErr):sub(1, 60), "err")
				end

		end

		end)

local function splitPath(input)
	local matchs = {}

	for match in trimText(input):gmatch("[^%.]+") do
		table.insert(matchs, match)
	end

	return matchs
end

local function lookupByServiceName(input)
	local splitPathResult = splitPath(input)

	if #splitPathResult ~= 0 then
		local result = entriesRun[splitPathResult[1]]

		if not result then
			local function getService()
				return game:GetService(splitPathResult[1])
			end

			local tempValue
			tempValue, result = pcall(getService)
			if not tempValue then
				return nil, "unknown root: " .. splitPathResult[1]
			end

			if not result then
				return nil, "unknown root: " .. splitPathResult[1]
			end
		end

		for index = 2, #splitPathResult do
			local pathNotFoundAt = splitPathResult[index]

			if result == Players and pathNotFoundAt == "LocalPlayer" then
				result = localPlayer
				if result then
					continue
				end
				return nil, "path not found at: " .. pathNotFoundAt
			end

			if result == localPlayer and pathNotFoundAt == "PlayerGui" then
				result = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
				if result then
					continue
				end
				return nil, "path not found at: " .. pathNotFoundAt
			end

			if result == localPlayer and pathNotFoundAt == "Character" then
				result = localPlayer.Character
				if result then
					continue
				end
				return nil, "path not found at: " .. pathNotFoundAt
			end

			if result == Workspace and pathNotFoundAt == "CurrentCamera" then
				result = Workspace.CurrentCamera
				if result then
					continue
				end
				return nil, "path not found at: " .. pathNotFoundAt
			end

			if typeof(result) ~= "Instance" then
				return nil, "path not found at: " .. pathNotFoundAt
			end
			result = result:FindFirstChild(pathNotFoundAt)
			if result then
				continue
			end
			return nil, "path not found at: " .. pathNotFoundAt
		end

		return result
	end

	return nil, "path is empty"
end

local function flattenChildren(container, threshold, input)
	local children = container:GetChildren()
	local count = 1
	local count2 = 0

	while count <= #children do
		if count2 < threshold then
			local child = children[count]
			count += 1
			count2 += 1
			if input(child, count2) then
				return count2, true
			end

			if #children < threshold then
				local children2 = child:GetChildren()

				for _, item in ipairs(children2) do
					if not (threshold <= #children) then
						table.insert(children, item)
						continue
					end
					break
				end
			end

			continue
		end

		break
	end

	return count2, false
end

local function parseColor3(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local number = tonumber(value[1] or value.r)
	local numberRun = tonumber(value[2] or value.g)
	local number2 = tonumber(value[3] or value.b)

	if number then
		if numberRun then
			if number2 then
				if number <= 1 and numberRun <= 1 and number2 <= 1 then
					return Color3.new(number, numberRun, number2)
				end
				return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(clampValue(number, 0, 255, 0)), math.floor(clampValue(numberRun, 0, 255,
					0)), math.floor(clampValue(number2, 0, 255, 0)))
			end

			return nil
		end

		return nil
	end

	return nil
end

local function toUDim2(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	return UDim2.new(tonumber(value[1] or value.xScale) or 0, tonumber(value[2] or value.xOffset) or 0,
		tonumber(value[3] or value.yScale) or 0, tonumber(value[4] or value.yOffset) or 0)
end

local function parseVector2(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local vector2New = Vector2.new
	local number = tonumber(value[1] or value.x) or 0
	local numberRun = tonumber(value[2] or value.y)
	if numberRun then
		return vector2New(number, numberRun)
	end
	return vector2New(number, 0)
end

local function parseUDim(value)
	if type(value) ~= "number" then
		if type(value) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end
		local uDimNew = UDim.new
		local number = tonumber(value[1] or value.scale) or 0
		local numberRun = tonumber(value[2] or value.offset)
		if numberRun then
			return uDimNew(number, numberRun)
		end
		return uDimNew(number, 0)
	end

	return UDim.new(0, value)
end

local function convertProperty(keyName, text)
	if colorProps[keyName] then
		return parseColor3(text)
	end

	if udim2Props[keyName] then
		return toUDim2(text)
	end

	if vector2Props[keyName] then
		return parseVector2(text)
	end

	if udimProps2[keyName] then
		return parseUDim(text)
	end

	if enumProps[keyName] then
		if typeof(text) ~= "EnumItem" then
			return enumProps[keyName][tostring(text):match("([^%.]+)$")]
		end
		return text
	end

	return text
end

local function applyProperties(properties, value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return { applied = 0, rejected = {} }
	end
	local list2 = {}
	local pairsResult, tempValue, tempValueRun = pairs(value)
	local count = 0

	for index, item in pairsResult, tempValue, tempValueRun do
		if udimProps[index] then
			local convertPropertyResult = convertProperty(index, item)

			if convertPropertyResult ~= nil then
				local callResult, result = pcall(function()
					properties[index] = convertPropertyResult
				end)

				if callResult then
					count += 1
				else
					table.insert(list2, { property = index, reason = tostring(result) })
				end
			else
				table.insert(list2, { property = index, reason = "invalid_value" })
			end
		else
			table.insert(list2, { property = tostring(index), reason = "not_allowed" })
		end
	end

	return { applied = count, rejected = list2 }
end

local function findInstanceByPath(input)
	local mcpGui, tempValue = findMcpGui(false)

	if mcpGui then
		local match = trimText(input)

		if match ~= "" and match ~= name then
			for match2 in match:gmatch("[^%.]+") do
				if match2 ~= name then
					mcpGui = mcpGui:FindFirstChild(match2)
					if mcpGui then
						continue
					end
					return nil, "managed UI path not found: " .. match2
				end
			end
		end

		return mcpGui
	end

	if tempValue then
		return nil, tempValue
	end
	return nil, "managed UI does not exist"
end

local eventNames = { Activated = true, MouseButton1Click = true, FocusLost = true }

local function waitForEvent(data, value)
	if type(value) == "table" then
		for _, item in ipairs(value) do
			if eventNames[item] then
				local callResult, result = pcall(function()
					return data[item]
				end)

				if callResult and result and type(result.Connect) == "function" then
					local connection = result:Connect(function(...)
						local entries = { ... }
						emitRpcEvent("ui." .. item, { path = getInstancePath(data), name = data.Name, className = data.ClassName,
							arguments = tempValue60(entries) })
					end)

					table.insert(connections2, connection)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local tempValue61

tempValue61 = function(value, parent, amount, input)
	if amount > 10 then
		error("UI tree exceeds maximum depth of 10")
	end

	if input.count >= 250 then
		error("UI tree exceeds maximum of 250 objects")
	end

	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		error("UI node must be an object")
	end

	local match = trimText(value.class or value.className)

	if not enabledFlags[match] then
		error("UI class is not allowed: " .. match)
	end

	input.count = input.count + 1
	local instance = Instance.new(match)
	local name2

	if trimText(value.name) ~= "" then
		name2 = trimText(value.name):sub(1, 64) or match .. input.count
	else
		name2 = match .. input.count
	end

	instance.Name = name2
	local applyPropertiesResult = applyProperties(instance, value.props)
	instance.Parent = parent
	waitForEvent(instance, value.events)
	local tempValue

	if type(value.children) ~= "table" then
		tempValue = {}
	else
		tempValue = value.children or {}
	end

	for _, item in ipairs(tempValue) do
		tempValue61(item, instance, amount + 1, input)
	end

	return instance, applyPropertiesResult
end

local tempValue62

tempValue62 = function(container, amount, threshold)
	local describeInstanceResult = describeInstance(container)
	if threshold <= amount then
		describeInstanceResult.truncated = #container:GetChildren() > 0
		return describeInstanceResult
	end
	describeInstanceResult.children = {}

	for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		table.insert(describeInstanceResult.children, tempValue62(child, amount + 1, threshold))
	end

	return describeInstanceResult
end

local bestValue6 = 80
local idMap = {}

local function formatArgs(...)
	local selectFn = select
	local packedArgs = table.pack(...)
	packedArgs.n = 2 + packedArgs.n - 1
	table.move(packedArgs, 1, packedArgs.n, 2, packedArgs)
	packedArgs[1] = "#"
	local parts = {}

	for index = 1, selectFn(table.unpack(packedArgs, 1, packedArgs.n)) do
		local tostringFn = tostring
		local value = select(index, ...)
		parts[index] = tostringFn(value)
	end

	return table.concat(parts, " ")
end

local function compileChunk(input, inputRun)
	local text = tostring(input or "")

	if text:match("^%s*$") then
		error("Code is empty", 0)
	end

	local textValue = "=" .. tostring(inputRun or "WebConsole"):sub(1, 60)
	local chunk, textRun = loadstring(text, textValue)
	if chunk then
		return chunk
	end
	local chunk2 = loadstring("return " .. text, textValue)
	if chunk2 then
		return chunk2
	end
	error("Syntax error: " .. tostring(textRun), 0)
	return chunk
end

local function createSandboxEnv(input)
	local env = getfenv(0)

	local obj = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = env,
		__newindex = function(unused, keyName, inputRun)
			env[keyName] = inputRun
		end,
	})

	rawset(obj, "print", function(...)
		input("print", formatArgs(...))
		if tempValue54 then
			print(...)
			return
		end
	end)

	rawset(obj, "warn", function(...)
		input("warn", formatArgs(...))
		if tempValue54 then
			warn(...)
			return
		end
	end)

	return obj
end

local function describeValue(value)
	local kind = typeof(value)
	local callResult, result = pcall(tostring, value)
	local state = { type = kind }
	local tempValue

	if callResult then
		tempValue = tostring(result) or "<unprintable>"
	else
		tempValue = "<unprintable>"
	end

	state.text = tempValue:sub(1, 4000)
	local tempValueRun

	if kind ~= "nil" then
		tempValueRun = tempValue60(value) or nil
	else
		tempValueRun = nil
		state.value = tempValueRun
		return state
	end

	state.value = tempValueRun
	return state
end

local function formatReturnValues(input, elapsedMs, inputRun, outputTruncated)
	local returns = {}
	local returnsInfo = {}

	for index = 2, input.n do
		returns[index - 1] = tempValue60(input[index])
		returnsInfo[index - 1] = describeValue(input[index])
	end

	local state = { output = table.concat(inputRun, "\n") }
	state.outputTruncated = outputTruncated or nil
	state.returns = returns
	state.returnsInfo = returnsInfo
	state.returnCount = input.n - 1
	state.elapsedMs = elapsedMs
	return state
end

local function getTraceback(text)
	return debug.traceback(tostring(text), 2)
end

local function flushOutput(items)
	if #items.pending ~= 0 then
		local pending = items.pending
		items.pending = {}
		emitRpcEvent("exec.output", { runId = items.id, label = items.label, lines = pending })
		return
	end
end

local function getPlayerHumanoid(player, input)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid, humanoidRootPart

	if character then
		humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	else
		humanoid = character
		humanoidRootPart = character
	end

	local state = {}
	state.name = player.Name
	state.displayName = player.DisplayName
	state.userId = player.UserId
	state.accountAge = player.AccountAge
	local name2

	if player.Team then
		name2 = player.Team.Name or nil
	else
		name2 = nil
	end

	state.team = name2
	state.neutral = player.Neutral
	local name3

	if character then
		name3 = character.Name or nil
	else
		name3 = nil
	end

	state.character = name3
	local health

	if humanoid then
		health = humanoid.Health or nil
	else
		health = nil
	end

	state.health = health
	local maxHealth

	if humanoid then
		maxHealth = humanoid.MaxHealth or nil
	else
		maxHealth = nil
	end

	state.maxHealth = maxHealth
	local tempValue

	if input then
		if humanoidRootPart then
			tempValue = tempValue60(humanoidRootPart.Position) or nil
		else
			tempValue = nil
			state.position = tempValue
			return state
		end
	else
		tempValue = nil
		state.position = tempValue
		return state
	end

	state.position = tempValue
	return state
end

local function navigateInstance(input)
	local match = trimText(input.path)
	local instanceByPath, tempValue = findInstanceByPath(match)

	if not instanceByPath then
		if match == "" then
			return { deleted = false, reason = "managed UI does not exist" }
		end
		error(tempValue)
	end

	disconnectAll(connections2)
	local instancePath = getInstancePath(instanceByPath)
	instanceByPath:Destroy()
	return { deleted = true, path = instancePath }
end

		if not notifications then
			notifications = Instance.new("Frame")
			notifications.Name = "Notifications"
			notifications.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
			notifications.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16)
			notifications.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 500)
			notifications.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			notifications.Parent = mcpGui
			local uiListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
			uiListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
			uiListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
			uiListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
			uiListLayout.Parent = notifications
		end

		local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		local name2 = "Notification_" .. HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
		textLabel.Name = name2
		textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 64)
		textLabel.BackgroundColor3 = parseColor3(input.color) or Color3.new(0.098039217293262482,
			0.13725490868091583, 0.20392157137393951)
		textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
		textLabel.Text = tostring(input.text):sub(1, 500)
		textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0.94117647409439087, 0.9686274528503418, 1)
		textLabel.TextSize = 16
		textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
		textLabel.TextWrapped = true
		textLabel.Parent = notifications
		local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
		uiCorner.Parent = textLabel
		local numVal = clampValue(input.duration, 0.5, 30, 4)

		local function closeNotice()
			if textLabel.Parent then
				textLabel:Destroy()
				return
			end
		end

		task.delay(numVal, closeNotice)
		return { shown = true, name = textLabel.Name, duration = numVal }
	end,
}

local function handleRpcRequest(input)
	local text = tostring(input.requestId or "")
	local unknownOrDisallowedMethod = tostring(input.method or "")
	local commandHandler = commandHandlers[unknownOrDisallowedMethod]

	if text ~= "" then
		if not commandHandler then
			sendRpcEvent({
				type = "rpc_result",
				requestId = text,
				success = false,
				error = "Unknown or disallowed method: " .. unknownOrDisallowedMethod,
			})

			return
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			local callResult, result = xpcall(function()
				local params

				if type(input.params) ~= "table" then
					params = {}
				else
					params = input.params
					if not params then
						params = {}
						return commandHandler(params)
					end
				end

				return commandHandler(params)
			end, function(textRun)
				return debug.traceback(tostring(textRun), 2)
			end)

			if callResult then
				sendRpcEvent({ type = "rpc_result", requestId = text, success = true, data = tempValue60(result) })
				return
			end
			sendRpcEvent({ type = "rpc_result", requestId = text, success = false, error = tostring(result):sub(1,
				2000) })
		end)

		return
	end
end

local function handleRequest(text)
	local function jsonDecode()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(tostring(text))
	end

	local callResult, result = pcall(jsonDecode)

	if callResult then
		if type(result) ~= "table" then
			warnMcp("Invalid JSON message")
			return
		end

		if result.type ~= "identify_ok" then
			if result.type ~= "pong" then
				if result.type ~= "rpc_request" then
					if result.type ~= "identify_error" then
						return
					end
					warnMcp("Bridge rejected identity:", tostring(result.error))
					return
				end

				handleRpcRequest(result)
				return
			end

			local tostringFn = tostring
			logMcp("PONG", tostringFn(result.seq or ""))
			return
		end

		logMcp("Connected to bridge. Client ID:", tostring(result.clientId))
		local entries = {}

		for value in pairs(commandHandlers) do
			table.insert(entries, value)
		end

		table.sort(entries)
		emitRpcEvent("agent.ready", { clientId = result.clientId, methods = entries,
			playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers() })
		return
	end

	warnMcp("Invalid JSON message")
end

local function closeSocket()
	tempValue57 = false
	disconnectAll(list)

	if tempValue58 then
		pcall(function()
			if type(tempValue58.Close) ~= "function" then
				if type(tempValue58.close) ~= "function" then
					return
				end
				tempValue58:close()
				return
			end

			tempValue58:Close()
		end)

		tempValue58 = nil
		return
	end
end

local function openSocket()
	local webSocket, tempValue = findWebSocket()
	if not webSocket then
		warnMcp("No supported WebSocket API found")
		return false
	end
	countRun += 1
	local countRunRef = countRun
	logMcp("Connecting to", "wss://chillihub.pro/roblox-mcp?token=chp-7E0Yzx4yddoAozc9VNLsqTnA", "using", tempValue)

	local function socketConnect()
		return webSocket("wss://chillihub.pro/roblox-mcp?token=chp-7E0Yzx4yddoAozc9VNLsqTnA")
	end

	local callResult, result = pcall(socketConnect)

	if callResult and result then
		tempValue58 = result
		tempValue57 = true
		local onMessage = tryAllCalls(tempValue58, "OnMessage", "MessageReceived")
		local onClose = tryAllCalls(tempValue58, "OnClose", "Closed", "OnDisconnect")
		local onError = tryAllCalls(tempValue58, "OnError", "Error")

		local function onRpcMessage(input)
			handleRequest(input)
		end

		local connectEventResult = connectEvent(onMessage, onRpcMessage)

		if connectEventResult then
			table.insert(list, connectEventResult)

			local function onSocketClosed(...)
				tempValue57 = false
				warnMcp("Socket closed", ...)
			end

			local connectEventResultRun = connectEvent(onClose, onSocketClosed)

			if connectEventResultRun then
				table.insert(list, connectEventResultRun)
			end

			local function onSocketError(...)
				warnMcp("Socket error", ...)
				tempValue57 = false
			end

			local connectEventResult2 = connectEvent(onError, onSocketError)

			if connectEventResult2 then
				table.insert(list, connectEventResult2)
			end

			local sendRpcEventResult, tempValueRun = sendRpcEvent({
				type = "identify",
				clientType = "roblox",
				token = apiTokenRun,
				name = localPlayer.Name,
				displayName = localPlayer.DisplayName,
				userId = localPlayer.UserId,
				placeId = game.PlaceId,
				jobId = game.JobId,
				version = versionLabel,
			})

			if not sendRpcEventResult then
				warnMcp(tempValueRun)
				tempValue57 = false
			end

			task.spawn(function()
				while tempValue56 do
					if tempValue57 then
						task.wait(20)

						if tempValue56 and tempValue57 then
							count3 += 1
							local sendRpcEventResultRun, text = sendRpcEvent({ type = "ping", seq = count3 })

							if not sendRpcEventResultRun then
								warnMcp("Heartbeat failed:", tostring(text))
								tempValue57 = false
							end
						end

						continue
					end

					break
				end
			end)

			while tempValue56 do
				if tempValue57 and countRunRef == countRun then
					task.wait(0.5)
					continue
				end
				break
			end

			if countRunRef ~= countRun then
				return true
			end
			closeSocket()
			return true
		end

		warnMcp("Socket has no supported message event")
		closeSocket()
		return false
	end

	warnMcp("Connection failed:", tostring(result))
	return false
end

local function sendHeartbeat()
	if type(httpRequest) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end

	local callResult, body = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONEncode({
			token = apiTokenRun,
			userId = localPlayer.UserId,
			name = localPlayer.Name,
			displayName = localPlayer.DisplayName,
			placeId = game.PlaceId,
			jobId = game.JobId,
			version = versionLabel,
		})
	end)

	if callResult then
		local pcallFn = pcall
		local requestData = { Url = beatUrl, Method = "POST" }
		requestData.Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }
		requestData.Body = body
		local pcallFnResult, tempValue = pcallFn(httpRequest, requestData)

		if pcallFnResult and type(tempValue) == "table" and tonumber(tempValue.StatusCode) == 200 then
			local ok2, result = pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(tostring(tempValue.Body))
			end)

			if ok2 and type(result) == "table" then
				return result
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

task.spawn(function()
	local function formatNumber(text)
		if type(text) ~= "number" then
			return tostring(text)
		end
		return string.format("%.0f", text)
	end

	local txt = nil

	local function loadSeenChat()
		if isfile("ChilliLibrary/SAE_ChatSeen.txt") then
			txt = readfile("ChilliLibrary/SAE_ChatSeen.txt")
			return
		end
	end

	pcall(loadSeenChat)

	local function saveSeenChatOuter(input)
		local function saveSeenChat()
			if not isfolder("ChilliLibrary") then
				makefolder("ChilliLibrary")
			end

			writefile("ChilliLibrary/SAE_ChatSeen.txt", input)
		end

		pcall(saveSeenChat)
	end

	local amount = 0

	while tempValue56 do
		local sendHeartbeatResult = sendHeartbeat()

		if sendHeartbeatResult then
			amount = 0
		else
			amount = math.min(amount + 1, 4)
		end

		local factor = 60 * 2 ^ amount

		if sendHeartbeatResult then
			factor = clampValue(sendHeartbeatResult.interval, 5, 600, 30)

			if sendHeartbeatResult.connect == true and not tempValue59 and not tempValue57 then
				tempValue59 = true

				local function onPong()
					pcall(openSocket)
					tempValue59 = false
				end

				task.spawn(onPong)
			end

			local chat = sendHeartbeatResult.chat

			if type(chat) == "table" and chat.id ~= nil then
				local formatNumberResult = formatNumber(chat.id, 202756883)

				if formatNumberResult ~= txt then
					txt = formatNumberResult
					saveSeenChatOuter(formatNumberResult)
					local chilliShowChat = genv.ChilliShowChat

					if type(chilliShowChat) == "function" then
						pcall(chilliShowChat, chat.name, chat.text, chat.seconds)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		task.wait(factor * (0.85 + math.random() * 0.3))
	end

	logMcp("Agent stopped")
end)
